title: Python: Advanced Guide to Artificial Intelligence
description:
Demystify the complexity of machine learning techniques and create evolving, clever solutions to solve your problems

Key Features
Master supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised ML algorithms and their implementation
Build deep learning models for object detection, image classification, similarity learning, and more
Build, deploy, and scale end-to-end deep neural network models in a production environment
Book Description

This Learning Path is your complete guide to quickly getting to grips with popular machine learning algorithms. You'll be introduced to the most widely used algorithms in supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised machine learning, and learn how to use them in the best possible manner. Ranging from Bayesian models to the MCMC algorithm to Hidden Markov models, this Learning Path will teach you how to extract features from your dataset and perform dimensionality reduction by making use of Python-based libraries.

You'll bring the use of TensorFlow and Keras to build deep learning models, using concepts such as transfer learning, generative adversarial networks, and deep reinforcement learning. Next, you'll learn the advanced features of TensorFlow1.x, such as distributed TensorFlow with TF clusters, deploy production models with TensorFlow Serving. You'll implement different techniques related to object classification, object detection, image segmentation, and more.

By the end of this Learning Path, you'll have obtained in-depth knowledge of TensorFlow, making you the go-to person for solving artificial intelligence problems

This Learning Path includes content from the following Packt products:

Mastering Machine Learning Algorithms by Giuseppe Bonaccorso
Mastering TensorFlow 1.x by Armando Fandango
Deep Learning for Computer Vision by Rajalingappaa Shanmugamani
What you will learn
Explore how an ML model can be trained, optimized, and evaluated
Work with Autoencoders and Generative Adversarial Networks
Explore the most important Reinforcement Learning techniques
Build end-to-end deep learning (CNN, RNN, and Autoencoders) models
Who this book is for

This Learning Path is for data scientists, machine learning engineers, artificial intelligence engineers who want to delve into complex machine learning algorithms, calibrate models, and improve the predictions of the trained model.

You will encounter the advanced intricacies and complex use cases of deep learning and AI. A basic knowledge of programming in Python and some understanding of machine learning concepts are required to get the best out of this Learning Path.

If you purchased this book elsewhere, you can visit http://www.PacktPub.com/support and register to have the files e-mailed directly to you.

title: Supervised Learning with Python: Concepts and Practical Implementation Using Python
description:
Gain a thorough understanding of supervised learning algorithms by developing use cases with Python. You will study supervised learning concepts, Python code, datasets, best practices, resolution of common issues and pitfalls, and practical knowledge of implementing algorithms for structured as well as text and images datasets.

You’ll start with an introduction to machine learning, highlighting the differences between supervised, semi-supervised and unsupervised learning. In the following chapters you’ll study regression and classification problems, mathematics behind them, algorithms like Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, KNN, Naïve Bayes, and advanced algorithms like Random Forest, SVM, Gradient Boosting and Neural Networks. Python implementation is provided for all the algorithms. You’ll conclude with an end-to-end model development process including deployment and maintenance of the model.After reading Supervised Learning with Python you’ll have a broad understanding of supervised learning and its practical implementation, and be able to run the code and extend it in an innovative manner.
What You'll Learn
Review the fundamental building blocks and concepts of supervised learning using Python
Develop supervised learning solutions for structured data as well as text and images 
Solve issues around overfitting, feature engineering, data cleansing, and cross-validation for building best fit models
Understand the end-to-end model cycle from business problem definition to model deployment and model maintenance 
Avoid the common pitfalls and adhere to best practices while creating a supervised learning model using Python
Who This Book Is For
Data scientists or data analysts interested in best practices and standards for supervised learning, and using classification algorithms and regression techniques to develop predictive models.

title: Implementing Cryptography Using Python
description:
Learn to deploy proven cryptographic tools in your applications and services

Cryptography is, quite simply, what makes security and privacy in the digital world possible. Tech professionals, including programmers, IT admins, and security analysts, need to understand how cryptography works to protect users, data, and assets. Implementing Cryptography Using Python will teach you the essentials, so you can apply proven cryptographic tools to secure your applications and systems. Because this book uses Python, an easily accessible language that has become one of the standards for cryptography implementation, you’ll be able to quickly learn how to secure applications and data of all kinds.

In this easy-to-read guide, well-known cybersecurity expert Shannon Bray walks you through creating secure communications in public channels using public-key cryptography. You’ll also explore methods of authenticating messages to ensure that they haven’t been tampered with in transit. Finally, you’ll learn how to use digital signatures to let others verify the messages sent through your services.

Learn how to implement proven cryptographic tools, using easy-to-understand examples written in Python
Discover the history of cryptography and understand its critical importance in today’s digital communication systems
Work through real-world examples to understand the pros and cons of various authentication methods
Protect your end-users and ensure that your applications and systems are using up-to-date cryptography

title: Practical Python Data Visualization: A Fast Track Approach To Learning Data Visualization With Python
description:
Quickly start programming with Python 3 for data visualization with this step-by-step, detailed guide. This book’s programming-friendly approach using libraries such as leather, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Pandas will serve as a template for business and scientific visualizations.

You’ll begin by installing Python 3, see how to work in Jupyter notebook, and explore Leather, Python’s popular data visualization charting library. You’ll also be introduced to the scientific Python 3 ecosystem and work with the basics of NumPy, an integral part of that ecosystem. Later chapters are focused on various NumPy routines along with getting started with Scientific Data visualization using matplotlib. You’ll review the visualization of 3D data using graphs and networks and finish up by looking at data visualization with Pandas, including the visualization of COVID-19 data sets.

The code examples are tested on popular platforms like Ubuntu, Windows, and Raspberry Pi OS. WithPractical Python Data Visualization you’ll master the core concepts of data visualization with Pandas and the Jupyter notebook interface.

What You'll Learn
Review practical aspects of Python Data Visualization with programming-friendly abstractions 
Install Python 3 and Jupyter on multiple platforms including Windows, Raspberry Pi, and Ubuntu 
Visualize COVID-19 data sets with Pandas
Who This Book Is For
Data Science enthusiasts and professionals, Business analysts and managers, software engineers, data engineers.

Usted comenzará por instalar Python 3, ver cómo trabajar en Jupyter notebook, y explorar Cuero, la popular biblioteca de visualización de datos de Python. También se introducirá en el ecosistema científico Python 3 y trabajará con los fundamentos de NumPy, una parte integral de ese ecosistema. Los capítulos posteriores se centran en varias rutinas de NumPy junto con el inicio de la visualización de datos científicos utilizando matplotlib. title: Federated Learning with Python
description:
Learn how to design and deploy federated learning systems with Python in this comprehensive guide. You'll explore the challenges of centralized machine learning, understand the fundamentals of federated learning, and gain the skills to build scalable, private, and efficient distributed AI applications.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the benefits and challenges of federated learning compared to traditional centralized machine learning.
Learn the theoretical and conceptual foundations of federated learning.
Design and develop a federated learning system architecture suitable for real-world applications.
Implement federated learning systems and familiarize yourself with client-server interactions and data aggregation methods.
Explore real-world case studies and future trends to effectively apply federated learning in various industries.

Author(s)

Kiyoshi Nakayama, PhD, is an accomplished researcher in distributed systems and machine learning with academic and industry experience. George Jeno is a hands-on technologist specializing in AI system implementation. Together, they provide a balanced perspective combining theoretical insights with practical applications.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for machine learning engineers, data scientists, and AI professionals eager to delve into federated learning. It is suitable for those with a working knowledge of Python and machine learning who aspire to build systems that preserve data privacy and scalability. The content progresses from foundational concepts to implementation, catering to learners aiming to apply federated learning in practical scenarios.

title: Getting Along
description:
Named one of "22 new books…that you should consider reading before the year is out" by Fortune

"This practical and empathetic guide to taking the high road is worth a look for workers lost in conflict." — Publisher's Weekly

A research-based, practical guide for how to handle difficult people at work.

Work relationships can be hard. The stress of dealing with difficult people dampens our creativity and productivity, degrades our ability to think clearly and make sound decisions, and causes us to disengage. We might lie awake at night worrying, withdraw from work, or react in ways we later regret—rolling our eyes in a meeting, snapping at colleagues, or staying silent when we should speak up.

Too often we grin and bear it as if we have no choice. Or throw up our hands because one-size-fits-all solutions haven't worked. But you can only endure so much thoughtless, irrational, or malicious behavior—there's your sanity to consider, and your career.

In Getting Along, workplace expert and Harvard Business Review podcast host Amy Gallo identifies eight familiar types of difficult coworkers—the insecure boss, the passive-aggressive peer, the know-it-all, the biased coworker, and others—and provides strategies tailored to dealing constructively with each one. She also shares principles that will help you turn things around, no matter who you're at odds with. Taking the high road isn't easy, but Gallo offers a crucial perspective on how work relationships really matter, as well as the compassion, encouragement, and tools you need to prevail—on your terms. She answers questions such as: Why can't I stop thinking about that nasty email?! What's behind my problem colleague's behavior? How can I fix things if they won't cooperate? I've tried everything—what now?

Full of relatable, sometimes cringe-worthy examples, the latest behavioral science research, and practical advice you can use right now, Getting Along is an indispensable guide to navigating your toughest relationships at work—and building interpersonal resilience in the process.
translatedDescription:
Nombrado uno de "22 nuevos libros... que deberías considerar leer antes de que el año esté fuera" por Fortune

"Esta guía práctica y empática para tomar el camino alto vale la pena buscar a los trabajadores perdidos en conflicto." — El semanario del editor

Una guía práctica basada en la investigación para cómo manejar a las personas difíciles en el trabajo.

Las relaciones laborales pueden ser difíciles. El estrés de lidiar con las personas difíciles amortigua nuestra creatividad y productividad, degrada nuestra capacidad de pensar con claridad y tomar decisiones sólidas, y nos hace desconectar. Podemos estar despiertos por la noche preocupándonos, retirándonos del trabajo, o reaccionando de maneras que más tarde nos arrepientamos: rodando los ojos en una reunión, rompiendo con los colegas, o permaneciendo en silencio cuando debamos hablar.

Con demasiada frecuencia nos reñimos y lo soportamos como si no tuviéramos elección. O tirar nuestras manos porque no han funcionado todas las soluciones. Pero sólo puedes soportar tanto comportamiento insensato, irracional o malicioso, hay tu cordura que considerar, y tu carrera.

Consiguiendo, el experto en el trabajo y el anfitrión de Harvard Business Review, Amy Gallo identifica ocho tipos familiares de compañeros de trabajo difíciles, el jefe inseguro, el par pasivo agresivo, el conocido, el compañero de trabajo sesgado y otros, y proporciona estrategias adaptadas para tratar de manera constructiva con cada uno. También comparte principios que te ayudarán a cambiar las cosas, no importa con quién estés en desacuerdo. Tomar el camino no es fácil, pero Gallo ofrece una perspectiva crucial sobre cómo las relaciones de trabajo realmente importan, así como la compasión, el aliento y las herramientas que usted necesita para prevalecer, en sus términos. Ella responde preguntas como: ¿Por qué no puedo dejar de pensar en ese correo desagradable?! ¿Qué hay detrás del comportamiento de mi colega problemático? ¿Cómo puedo arreglar las cosas si no cooperan? Lo he intentado todo, ¿y ahora qué?

Lleno de ejemplos relatables, a veces dignos de cringe, la última investigación científica conductual, y consejos prácticos que puedes utilizar ahora mismo, Cómodo es una guía indispensable para navegar por tus relaciones más duras en el trabajo, y construir resiliencia interpersonal en el proceso.

title: Python for Teenagers: Learn to Program like a Superhero!
description:
This book, which is designed for middle-school through college-aged students, will arm beginners with solid programming foundations they can carry throughout life. It uses fun and simple language (and programming examples) to teach the fundamentals needed to start the down path of becoming a programmer. Python is a highly flexible language, allowing developers to enter any number of technical fields and is a welcome addition to any resume. With its low learning curve, it makes a great introductory language, as new developers can take the coding fundamentals they learn in Python and apply them to any other language. 

 

The second edition builds upon the foundation of the first book, revising all the chapters where the language has changed, updating the commands, code, and examples to bring it up to date with the current version of Python.

 

Since Python is the most popular programming language in the world and can be used in conjunctionwith other languages - across multiple platforms - it can increase the reader's ability to qualify for a wider range of jobs than other languages. Finally, Python is fun - something not every programming language can boast!

 

What You Will Learn

Install and configure Python
Grasp basic software development principles and syntax
Understand the best practices for coding in Python
Create applications and debug code

 

Who This Book Is For

The book’s target audience is primarily middle school to college aged students looking to learn how to program computers and develop software. Older individuals and computer programmers who know other languages and want to add Python to their repertoire can also benefit from the book.

title: Learning Predictive Analytics with Python
description:
"Learning Predictive Analytics with Python" is your hands-on guide to mastering predictive modelling through Python. By working through intuitive explanations and practical examples, you'll understand how to use Python libraries like pandas and scikit-learn to create effective predictive models for various real-world datasets.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the theory and mathematics underpinning predictive modelling algorithms and implement them programmatically.
Acquaint yourself with practical data processing techniques, including cleaning and manipulation, using Python's pandas and numpy libraries.
Gain proficiency in applying predictive analytics methods such as Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, and Clustering.
Develop skill in writing and modifying Python code for building and testing predictive models from scratch.
Learn best practices and troubleshooting strategies for deploying predictive analytics solutions on real-world data.

Author(s)

None Kumar and Gary Dougan together bring extensive experience in data science and Python programming. Having published work in machine learning and predictive analytics applications, they blend practical knowledge with theoretical insights. Their approach is to teach complex topics in an accessible and straightforward manner, focusing on hands-on learning.

Who is it for?

"Learning Predictive Analytics with Python" is aimed at data scientists, analysts, and Python programmers eager to delve into predictive analytics. It is ideal for readers with some prior coding experience but beginners in predictive modelling. Aspiring data science professionals and enthusiasts with a solid Python foundation will find this book insightful as they embark on their predictive analytics journey.
translatedDescription:
"Aprender análisis predictivos con Python" es su guía práctica para dominar el modelado predictivo a través de Python. Al trabajar a través de explicaciones intuitivas y ejemplos prácticos, comprenderás cómo utilizar las bibliotecas de Python como pandas y scikit-learn para crear modelos predictivos eficaces para varios conjuntos de datos del mundo real.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender la teoría y las matemáticas que sustentan algoritmos de modelado predictivo e implementarlos programáticamente.
Cuéntase con técnicas prácticas de procesamiento de datos, incluyendo limpieza y manipulación, utilizando pandas de Python y bibliotecas numposas.
Gain proficiency in applying predictive analytics methods such as Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, and Clustering.
Desarrollar habilidad por escrito y modificar el código Python para construir y probar modelos predictivos desde cero.
Aprende mejores prácticas y estrategias de solución de problemas para implementar soluciones de análisis predictivos en datos reales.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Kumar y Gary Dougan reúnen una amplia experiencia en la ciencia de datos y la programación de Python. Habiendo publicado trabajo en aplicaciones de aprendizaje automático y análisis predictivos, mezclan conocimientos prácticos con ideas teóricas. Su enfoque es enseñar temas complejos de una manera accesible y sencilla, centrándose en el aprendizaje práctico.

¿Para quién es?

"Aprender análisis predictivos con Python" está dirigido a científicos de datos, analistas y programadores Python ansiosos de profundizar en análisis predictivos. Es ideal para lectores con alguna experiencia de codificación previa pero principiantes en modelado predictivo. Los profesionales y entusiastas de la ciencia de datos inspiradores con una sólida fundación de Python encontrarán este libro perspicaz mientras se embarcan en su viaje de análisis predictivo.

title: Row the Boat
description:
Learn to live and lead with enthusiasm and optimism, impact your team, and transform your culture  

In Row the Boat, Minnesota Golden Gophers Head Coach P.J. Fleck and bestselling author Jon Gordon deliver an inspiring message about what you can achieve when you approach life with a never-give-up philosophy. The book shows you how to choose enthusiasm and optimism as your guiding lights instead of being defined by circumstances and events outside of your control.  

Discover how to put the three key components of row the boat into practice in your life:  

The Oar: The energy. Only you can dictate whether your oar is in the water or whether you take it out and decide not to use it.  
The Boat: The sacrifice. The more you give, serve, and make your life about helping others, the better and more fulfilled your life will be, and the bigger your boat gets.  
The Compass: The direction. The vision you have for your life and the people you surround yourself with help create the dream of where you want to go.  

Perfect for athletes, coaches, business leaders, and anyone else who hopes to squeeze a little more enjoyment and productivity out of life, Row the Boat will propel leaders, teams, and organizations to greater heights than they have ever reached before.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a vivir y liderar con entusiasmo y optimismo, impacta a tu equipo y transforma tu cultura

En Row the Boat, Minnesota Golden Gophers Head Coach P.J. Fleck y autor bestselling Jon Gordon ofrecen un mensaje inspirador sobre lo que puedes lograr cuando te acercas a la vida con una filosofía que nunca se da cuenta. El libro le muestra cómo elegir el entusiasmo y el optimismo como sus luces guía en lugar de ser definidos por circunstancias y eventos fuera de su control.

Descubre cómo poner en práctica los tres componentes clave de la hilera en tu vida:

El Oar: La energía. Sólo usted puede dictar si su oido está en el agua o si usted lo toma y decide no utilizarlo.
El barco: el sacrificio. Cuanto más da, sirve y hace su vida sobre ayudar a los demás, mejor y más cumplida será su vida, y más grande será su barco.
El Compass: La dirección. La visión que tienes para tu vida y las personas que te rodean con ayuda crean el sueño de donde quieres ir.

Perfecto para deportistas, entrenadores, líderes de negocios, y cualquier otra persona que desee exprimir un poco más de disfrute y productividad de la vida, Row the Boat propulsará a líderes, equipos y organizaciones a mayores alturas de lo que han alcanzado antes.

title: Managing Systems and IT Projects
description: This book is designed for software engineering students and project management professional in the IT and software industry. It focuses on the four phases of management -- planning, organizing, monitoring, and adjusting (POMA) -- and tailors to systems and applications on software projects. The tasks and techniques utilized in each of the POMA management phases are discussed with specific software engineering and IT related examples. Drawing from years of experience in the industry, the author presents material within a framework of real-world examples and exercises that help readers apply new concepts to everyday situations.
translatedDescription: Este libro está diseñado para estudiantes de ingeniería de software y profesionales de gestión de proyectos en la industria de TI y software. Se centra en las cuatro fases de gestión: planificación, organización, seguimiento y ajuste (POMA) y adaptadores a sistemas y aplicaciones en proyectos de software. Las tareas y técnicas utilizadas en cada una de las fases de gestión de POMA se examinan con ejemplos específicos relacionados con la ingeniería de software y la TI. Partiendo de años de experiencia en la industria, el autor presenta material dentro de un marco de ejemplos y ejercicios reales que ayudan a los lectores a aplicar nuevos conceptos a situaciones cotidianas.

title: Python Game Programming By Example
description:
"Python Game Programming by Example" is your step-by-step guide to creating exciting and interactive games using Python. Through its accessible and example-driven approach, you will learn how to utilize popular Python libraries to build a variety of games, from simple concepts to more advanced 3D designs.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the basics of Python programming applied to game development.
Create classic 2D games such as Pong and Space Invaders.
Explore and implement game physics and AI for enhanced gameplay.
Develop 3D games using libraries like PyGame and Cocos2d.
Learn to integrate graphical user interfaces in your game projects using Tkinter and other tools.

Author(s)

Alejandro Rodas de Paz and Joseph Howse are experienced developers with expertise in Python and game development. Alejandro brings his passion for education and coding, while Joseph's work includes AI and computer vision programming. Together, they craft approachable and comprehensive learning materials.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for beginners in Python programming who are interested in game development. If you aspire to learn foundational game design principles while building practical projects, this book is for you. Readers with little to no prior coding experience will benefit from its step-by-step instructions. Whether you are a hobbyist, a student, or an aspiring developer, you'll find this book to be a valuable resource.

"Python Game Programming by Ejemplo" es su guía paso a paso para crear juegos emocionantes e interactivos usando Python. A través de su enfoque accesible y basado en ejemplos, usted aprenderá a utilizar las bibliotecas populares Python para construir una variedad de juegos, desde conceptos simples a diseños 3D más avanzados.

Entender los fundamentos de la programación Python aplicada al desarrollo del juego.
Cree juegos 2D clásicos como Pong y Space Invaders.

Desarrollar juegos 3D usando bibliotecas como PyGame y Cocos2d.

Este libro es ideal para principiantes en la programación de Python que están interesados en el desarrollo del juego. Si aspiras a aprender principios fundamentales de diseño del juego al construir proyectos prácticos, este libro es para ti. Los lectores con poca o ninguna experiencia de codificación previa se beneficiarán de sus instrucciones paso a paso. Si usted es un hobbyista, un estudiante o un aspirante desarrollador, encontrará que este libro es un recurso valioso.

title: Machine Learning Applications Using Python: Cases Studies from Healthcare, Retail, and Finance
description:
Gain practical skills in machine learning for finance, healthcare, and retail. This book uses a hands-on approach by providing case studies from each of these domains: you’ll see examples that demonstrate how to use machine learning as a tool for business enhancement. As a domain expert, you will not only discover how machine learning is used in finance, healthcare, and retail, but also work through practical case studies where machine learning has been implemented. 
Machine Learning Applications Using Python is divided into three sections, one for each of the domains (healthcare, finance, and retail). Each section starts with an overview of machine learning and key technological advancements in that domain. You’ll then learn more by using case studies on how organizations are changing the game in their chosen markets. This book has practical case studies with Python code and domain-specific innovative ideas for monetizing machine learning. 
What You Will Learn
Discover applied machine learning processes and principles
Implement machine learning in areas of healthcare, finance, and retail
Avoid the pitfalls of implementing applied machine learning
Build Python machine learning examples in the three subject areas
Who This Book Is For
Data scientists and machine learning professionals.

Obtenga habilidades prácticas en el aprendizaje automático para las finanzas, la salud y el retail. Este libro utiliza un enfoque práctico proporcionando estudios de casos de cada uno de estos dominios: verá ejemplos que demuestren cómo utilizar el aprendizaje automático como una herramienta para mejorar el negocio. Como experto en dominio, no sólo descubrirá cómo se utiliza el aprendizaje automático en finanzas, salud y retail, sino que también trabajará a través de estudios prácticos de casos donde se ha implementado el aprendizaje automático.
Aplicaciones de aprendizaje automático Usando Python se divide en tres secciones, una para cada uno de los dominios (salud, finanzas y retail). Cada sección comienza con una visión general del aprendizaje automático y avances tecnológicos clave en ese ámbito. Luego aprenderás más utilizando estudios de casos sobre cómo las organizaciones están cambiando el juego en sus mercados elegidos. Este libro tiene estudios prácticos de casos con código Python e ideas innovadoras específicas para el aprendizaje de máquinas monetizantes.
Qué aprenderás
Descubra los procesos y principios aplicados de aprendizaje automático
Implementar el aprendizaje automático en áreas de salud, finanzas y retail
Evitar los obstáculos de la implementación de aprendizaje automático aplicado
Construir ejemplos de aprendizaje automático Python en las tres áreas temáticas
Quién es este libro
Científicos de datos y profesionales del aprendizaje automático.

title: Advanced Data Analytics Using Python: With Architectural Patterns, Text and Image Classification, and Optimization Techniques
description:
Understand advanced data analytics concepts such as time series and principal component analysis with ETL, supervised learning, and PySpark using Python. This book covers architectural patterns in data analytics, text and image classification, optimization techniques, natural language processing, and computer vision in the cloud environment.
Generic design patterns in Python programming is clearly explained, emphasizing architectural practices such as hot potato anti-patterns. You'll review recent advances in databases such as Neo4j, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB. You'll then study feature engineering in images and texts with implementing business logic and see how to build machine learning and deep learning models using transfer learning. 

Advanced Analytics with Python, 2nd edition features a chapter on clustering with a neural network, regularization techniques, and algorithmic design patterns in data analyticswith reinforcement learning. Finally, the recommender system in PySpark explains how to optimize models for a specific application. 

What You'll Learn
Build intelligent systems for enterprise
Review time series analysis, classifications, regression, and clustering
Explore supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and transfer learning 
Use cloud platforms like GCP and AWS in data analytics
Understand Covers design patterns in Python 
Who This Book Is For
Data scientists and software developers interested in the field of data analytics.
translatedDescription:
Entender conceptos avanzados de análisis de datos como series temporales y análisis de componentes principales con ETL, aprendizaje supervisado y PySpark usando Python. Este libro cubre patrones arquitectónicos en análisis de datos, clasificación de texto e imagen, técnicas de optimización, procesamiento de lenguaje natural y visión de ordenador en el entorno de la nube.
Los patrones de diseño genéricos en la programación de Python se explican claramente, haciendo hincapié en prácticas arquitectónicas como los antipatrones de patata caliente. Revisarás los avances recientes en bases de datos como Neo4j, Elasticsearch y MongoDB. Luego estudiará la ingeniería de características en imágenes y textos con la implementación de la lógica empresarial y ver cómo construir modelos de aprendizaje y aprendizaje profundo utilizando el aprendizaje de transferencia.

Análisis avanzado con Python, segunda edición cuenta con un capítulo sobre agrupación con una red neuronal, técnicas de regularización y patrones de diseño algorítmicos en análisis de datos con aprendizaje de refuerzo. Por último, el sistema recomendador en PySpark explica cómo optimizar los modelos para una aplicación específica.

Lo que aprenderás
Construir sistemas inteligentes para empresas
Análisis de series de tiempo de revisión, clasificaciones, regresión y agrupación
Explore el aprendizaje supervisado, el aprendizaje no supervisado, el aprendizaje de refuerzo y la transferencia de aprendizaje
Utilice plataformas de nubes como GCP y AWS en análisis de datos
Comprende los patrones de diseño de cubiertas en Python
Quién es este libro
Científicos de datos y desarrolladores de software interesados en el campo de la analítica de datos.

title: Python Developer's Handbook
description: The Python Developer's Handbook is designed to expose experienced developers to Python and its uses. Beginning with a brief introduction to the language and its syntax, the book moves quickly into more advanced programming topics, including embedding Python, network programming, GUI toolkits, JPython, Web development, Python/C API, and more. Python is an interpreted, object-oriented programming language. Its syntax is simple and easy to learn, and it encourages programmers to write and think clearly. The Python Developer's Handbook is carefully written, well-organized introduction to this powerful, fast-growing programming language for experienced developers.
translatedDescription: El Handbook de Python Developer está diseñado para exponer desarrolladores experimentados a Python y sus usos. Comenzando con una breve introducción al idioma y su sintaxis, el libro se mueve rápidamente en temas de programación más avanzados, incluyendo la incorporación de Python, programación de red, toolkits GUI, JPython, desarrollo web, Python/C API, y más. Python es un lenguaje de programación interpretado y orientado al objeto. Su sintaxis es simple y fácil de aprender, y anima a los programadores a escribir y pensar claramente. El Manual de Python Developer está escrito cuidadosamente, bien organizado introducción a este poderoso lenguaje de programación de rápido crecimiento para desarrolladores experimentados.

title: From PHP to Ruby on Rails
description:
If you're a PHP developer intrigued by Ruby on Rails, this book helps you make the leap efficiently and effectively. Leveraging your existing backend skills, "From PHP to Ruby on Rails" provides a structured guide to mastering Ruby fundamentals and understanding Rails conventions, while highlighting the differences and similarities in approach and syntax between PHP and Ruby.

What this Book will help me do

Understand Ruby syntax differences by directly comparing PHP and Ruby code examples.
Set up a development environment for Ruby on Rails with ease.
Learn to leverage Ruby-specific libraries, gems, and frameworks in applications.
Create robust Rails-based web applications with clear coding conventions.
Implement advanced features like session handling and authentication using Rails.

Author(s)

None Pineda, the author, is a passionate software developer who transitioned from PHP to Ruby and fell in love with its elegance. With a background in backend development, his teaching exemplifies clarity and relevance, helping programmers of various backgrounds bridge the gap between languages.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for PHP developers ranging from entry-level to professionals who are new to Ruby. If you're looking to explore Ruby on Rails while leveraging your previous programming knowledge, this book provides clear and structured guidance tailored for readers like you.
translatedDescription:
Si usted es un desarrollador PHP intrigado por Ruby on Rails, este libro le ayuda a hacer el salto eficiente y eficaz. Aprovechando sus habilidades de backend existentes, "De PHP a Ruby on Rails" proporciona una guía estructurada para dominar los fundamentos de Ruby y entender las convenciones de Rails, destacando las diferencias y similitudes en enfoque y sintaxis entre PHP y Ruby.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprenda las diferencias de sintaxis de Ruby comparando directamente los ejemplos de código PHP y Ruby.
Establecer un entorno de desarrollo para Ruby en Rails con facilidad.
Aprende a aprovechar bibliotecas, gemas y marcos específicos de Ruby en aplicaciones.
Cree aplicaciones web robustas basadas en Rails con convenios de codificación claros.
Implementar funciones avanzadas como manejo de sesión y autenticación usando Rails.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Pineda, el autor, es un desarrollador de software apasionado que pasó de PHP a Ruby y se enamoró de su elegancia. Con un trasfondo en el desarrollo de backend, su enseñanza ilustra la claridad y la pertinencia, ayudando a los programadores de diversos contextos a superar la brecha entre los idiomas.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores PHP que van desde el nivel de entrada a profesionales que son nuevos a Ruby. Si buscas explorar Ruby on Rails mientras aprovechas tu conocimiento de programación anterior, este libro proporciona una guía clara y estructurada adaptada para lectores como tú.

title: Change Your Questions, Change Your Life, 3rd Edition
description: NEW EDITION, EXPANDED AND UPDATEDGreat Results Begin with Great QuestionsIn this new expanded edition of her classic international bestseller, Marilee Adams shows how the kinds of questions we ask shape our thinking and can be the root cause of many personal and organizational problems. She uses a highly instructive and entertaining story to show how to quickly recognize any undermining questions that pop into your mind—or out of your mouth—and reframe them to achieve amazingly positive and practical results. The third edition includes a new introduction and epilogue and two powerful new tools that show how Question Thinking can dramatically improve coaching and leadership. Based on Adams's decades of research and experience, this book can make a life-transforming difference—as it already has for many thousands of people around the world.
translatedDescription: NUEVA EDICIÓN, EXPANDIDA Y AÑADIR Grandes Resultados Comience con Grandes PreguntasEn esta nueva edición ampliada de su clásico bestseller internacional, Marilee Adams muestra cómo los tipos de preguntas que hacemos moldean nuestro pensamiento y pueden ser la causa raíz de muchos problemas personales y organizativos. Ella utiliza una historia altamente instructiva y entretenida para mostrar cómo reconocer rápidamente cualquier pregunta que se mete en tu mente —o fuera de tu boca— y re-configurarlas para lograr resultados increíblemente positivos y prácticos. La tercera edición incluye una nueva introducción y un epílogo y dos poderosas nuevas herramientas que muestran cómo el pensamiento de preguntas puede mejorar dramáticamente el entrenamiento y el liderazgo. Basado en las décadas de investigación y experiencia de Adams, este libro puede hacer una diferencia que transforma la vida, como ya tiene para miles de personas en todo el mundo.

title: Swift for the Really Impatient
description:
Swift for the Really Impatient is the perfect jumpstart to the Swift language for every experienced Objective-C developer. Leading iOS and OS X developers Matt Henderson and Dave Wood help you take full advantage of Swift’s powerful innovations, without wasting time on basics you already know. Through expert code examples and crystal-clear explanations, Henderson and Wood reveal how Swift features improve on Objective-C and show how to make the most of them. You’ll quickly master “Swift-er” techniques for using objects, classes, optionals, generics, functions, closures, and more. Each chapter includes hands-on exercises designed to reinforce and deepen your skills. You’ll learn how to re-implement common Objective-C programming solutions in Swift, improving code clarity, power, and performance on both desktop and mobile devices. And, because you probably won’t (or can’t) abandon Objective-C anytime soon, you’ll discover how to use both languages together, smoothly integrate Swift into existing projects and workflows, and gradually move your current code base into the future. Coverage includes

Using Swift’s new patterns and concise, expressive syntax to produce safer, more reliable code

Leveraging the surprising power of Swift’s data structures

Utilizing Swift’s type system to help prevent errors common in other languages

Using optionals to correctly handle invalid, missing, or unknown values

Implementing generics to reduce duplication, improve power, and simplify maintenance

Interacting with C and Objective-C APIs

Abstracting functionality for reusable code while maintaining type safety

Isolating code in clean, flexible, low-overhead closures

Combining Swift with Objective-C in the same project

Avoiding gotchas when importing Objective-C classes in Swift projects

Nesting types to improve code clarity

Creating shared objects with singletons

Managing threading and concurrency with Swift’s advanced Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) patterns
translatedDescription:
Swift para el realmente impaciente es el salto perfecto al lenguaje Swift para cada desarrollador Objetivo-C experimentado. Los desarrolladores principales de iOS y OS X Matt Henderson y Dave Wood te ayudan a aprovechar plenamente las poderosas innovaciones de Swift, sin perder tiempo en lo básico que ya sabes. A través de ejemplos de código experto y explicaciones cristalinas, Henderson y Wood revelan cómo las características de Swift mejoran en Objetivo-C y muestran cómo sacar el máximo provecho de ellos. Usted dominará rápidamente las técnicas “Swift-er” para usar objetos, clases, opcionales, genéricos, funciones, cierres y más. Cada capítulo incluye ejercicios prácticos diseñados para reforzar y profundizar tus habilidades. Aprenderás a implementar soluciones comunes de programación Objetivo-C en Swift, mejorando la claridad del código, la potencia y el rendimiento tanto en dispositivos de escritorio como móviles. Y, debido a que probablemente no (o no puede) abandonar Objetivo-C en cualquier momento pronto, descubrirá cómo utilizar ambos idiomas juntos, integrar suavemente Swift en proyectos y flujos de trabajo existentes, y mover gradualmente su base de código actual en el futuro. La cobertura incluye

Utilizando los nuevos patrones de Swift y la sintaxis concisa y expresiva para producir código más seguro y fiable

Aprovechando el sorprendente poder de las estructuras de datos de Swift

Utilizar el sistema de tipo Swift para ayudar a prevenir errores comunes en otros idiomas

Utilizar opcionales para manejar correctamente valores inválidos, perdidos o desconocidos

Implementar genéricos para reducir la duplicación, mejorar el poder y simplificar el mantenimiento

Interacting with C and Objective-C APIs

Abstracting funcionalidad for reusable code while maintaining type safety

Código de aislamiento en cierres limpios, flexibles y de baja sobrecarga

Combinando Swift con Objective-C en el mismo proyecto

Evitar las gotas al importar clases de Objetivo-C en proyectos Swift

Tipos de anidación para mejorar la claridad del código

Creación de objetos compartidos con singletons

Gestionar la rosca y la concurrencia con los patrones avanzados Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) de Swift

title: The Daily Drucker
description:
Revered management thinker Peter F. Drucker is our trusted guide in this thoughtful, day-by-day companion that offers his penetrating and practical wisdom. Amid the multiple pressures of our daily work lives, The Daily Drucker provides the inspiration and advice to meet the many challenges we face. With his trademark clarity, vision, and humanity, Drucker sets out his ideas on a broad swath of key topics, from time management, to innovation, to outsourcing, providing useful insights for each day of the year.

These 366 daily readings have been harvested from Drucker's lifetime of work. At the bottom of each page, the reader will find an action point that spells out exactly how to put Drucker's ideas into practice. It is as if the wisest and most action-oriented management consultant in the world is in the room, offering his timeless gems of advice. The Daily Drucker is for anyone who seeks to understand and put to use Drucker's powerful words and ideas.
translatedDescription:
Pensador de gestión venerado Peter F. Drucker es nuestro guía de confianza en este reflexivo compañero de día a día que ofrece su penetrante y práctica sabiduría. En medio de las múltiples presiones de nuestra vida diaria de trabajo, The Daily Drucker proporciona la inspiración y el consejo para hacer frente a los muchos desafíos que enfrentamos. Con su claridad de marca, visión y humanidad, Drucker expone sus ideas sobre un amplio intercambio de temas clave, desde la gestión del tiempo, hasta la innovación, la externalización, proporcionando información útil para cada día del año.

Estas 366 lecturas diarias han sido cosechadas de la vida laboral de Drucker. En el fondo de cada página, el lector encontrará un punto de acción que describe exactamente cómo poner en práctica las ideas de Drucker. Es como si el consultor de gestión más sabio y orientado a la acción en el mundo estuviera en la sala, ofreciendo sus gemas de consejos atemporales. El Daily Drucker es para cualquiera que busca entender y usar las poderosas palabras e ideas de Drucker.

title: Use WebAssembly to Share Memory Between Hosts and Modules
description: WebAssembly (WASM) is a collection of standards for facilitating safe, fast, portable code, deployable into almost any modern runtime environment—browser, server, cloud, edge, embedded. These shortcuts will allow you to put WASM into action and experience how it could impact every aspect of how we build software.

Estos atajos le permitirán poner WASM en acción y experimentar cómo podría impactar cada aspecto de cómo construimos software.

title: Think for Yourself
description:
We've outsourced too much of our thinking. How do we get it back?

Have you ever followed your GPS device to a deserted parking lot? Or unquestioningly followed the advice of an expert—perhaps a doctor or financial adviser—only to learn later that your own thoughts and doubts were correct? And what about the stories we've all heard over the years about sick patients—whether infected with Ebola or COVID-19—who were sent home or allowed to travel because busy staff people were following a protocol to the letter rather than using common sense? Why and how do these kinds of things happen?

As Harvard lecturer and global trend watcher Vikram Mansharamani shows in this eye-opening and perspective-shifting book, our complex, data-flooded world has made us ever more reliant on experts, protocols, and technology. Too often, we've stopped thinking for ourselves. With stark and compelling examples drawn from business, sports, and everyday life, Mansharamani illustrates how in a very real sense we have outsourced our thinking to a troubling degree, relinquishing our autonomy.

Of course, experts, protocols, and computer-based systems are essential to helping us make informed decisions. What we need is a new approach for integrating these information sources more effectively, harnessing the value they provide without undermining our ability to think for ourselves. The author provides principles and techniques for doing just that, empowering readers with a more critical and nuanced approach to making decisions.

Think for Yourself is an indispensable guide for those looking to restore self-reliant thinking in a data-driven and technology-dependent yet overwhelmingly uncertain world.

Como Vikram Mansharamani, profesor de Harvard y vigilante mundial de tendencias, muestra en este libro de apertura de ojos y cambio de perspectiva, nuestro complejo mundo basado en datos nos ha hecho depender cada vez más de expertos, protocolos y tecnología. Demasiado a menudo, hemos dejado de pensar para nosotros mismos. Piensa para ti mismo es una guía indispensable para aquellos que buscan restaurar el pensamiento autosuficiente en un mundo basado en datos y que depende de la tecnología pero abrumadoramente incierto.

title: How Will You Measure Your Life? (Harvard Business Review Classics)
description:
In the spring of 2010, Harvard Business School’s graduating class asked HBS professor Clay Christensen to address them—but not on how to apply his principles and thinking to their post-HBS careers. The students wanted to know how to apply his wisdom to their personal lives. He shared with them a set of guidelines that have helped him find meaning in his own life, which led to this now-classic article. Although Christensen’s thinking is rooted in his deep religious faith, these are strategies anyone can use.

Since 1922, Harvard Business Review has been a leading source of breakthrough ideas in management practice. The Harvard Business Review Classics series now offers you the opportunity to make these seminal pieces a part of your permanent management library. Each highly readable volume contains a groundbreaking idea that continues to shape best practices and inspire countless managers around the world.

title: Ruby Performance Optimization
description: You don't have to accept slow Ruby or Rails performance. In this comprehensive guide to Ruby optimization, you'll learn how to write faster Ruby code--but that's just the beginning. See exactly what makes Ruby and Rails code slow, and how to fix it. Alex Dymo will guide you through perils of memory and CPU optimization, profiling, measuring, performance testing, garbage collection, and tuning. You'll find that all those "hard" things aren't so difficult after all, and your code will run orders of magnitude faster.This is the first book ever that consolidates all the Ruby performance optimization advice in one place. It's your comprehensive guide to memory optimization, CPU optimization, garbage collector tuning, profiling, measurements, performance testing, and more.You'll go from performance rookie to expert. First, you'll learn the best practices for writing Ruby code that's easy not only on the CPU, but also on memory, and that doesn't trigger the dreaded garbage collector. You'll find out that garbage collection accounts for 80% of slowdowns, and often takes more than 50% of your program's execution time. And you'll discover the bottlenecks in Rails code and learn how selective attribute loading and preloading can mitigate the performance costs of ActiveRecord.As you advance to Ruby performance expert, you'll learn how profile your code, how to make sense out of profiler reports, and how to make optimization decisions based on them. You'll make sure slow code doesn't creep back into your Ruby application by writing performance tests, and you'll learn the right way to benchmark Ruby. And finally, you'll dive into the Ruby interpreter internals to really understand why garbage collection makes Ruby so slow, and how you can tune it up. What You Need:Some version of Ruby. The advice from this book applies to all modern Ruby versions from 1.9 to 2.2. 80% of the material will also be useful for legacy Ruby 1.8 users, and there is 1.8-specific advice as well.
translatedDescription: No tienes que aceptar el lento rendimiento de Ruby o Rails. Vea exactamente lo que hace que el código Ruby y Rails lento, y cómo solucionarlo. Alex Dymo te guiará a través de los peligros de memoria y optimización de CPU, perfiles, medición, pruebas de rendimiento, recolección de basura y afinación. Encontrarás que todas esas cosas "difíciles" no son tan difíciles después de todo, y tu código ejecutará órdenes de magnitud más rápido. Este es el primer libro que consolida todos los consejos de optimización de rendimiento de Ruby en un solo lugar. Es su guía integral de optimización de memoria, optimización de CPU, afinación de basura, perfiles, mediciones, pruebas de rendimiento y más. Irás de novato de rendimiento a experto. En primer lugar, usted aprenderá las mejores prácticas para escribir código Ruby que es fácil no sólo en la CPU, sino también en la memoria, y que no activa el temido colector de basura. Usted descubrirá que la recolección de basura representa el 80% de las desaceleraciones, y a menudo toma más del 50% del tiempo de ejecución de su programa. Y descubrirás los cuellos de botella en el código Rails y aprenderás cómo la carga y la carga de atributos selectivos pueden mitigar los costos de rendimiento de ActiveRecord. A medida que avanza a Ruby experto en rendimiento, usted aprenderá cómo perfilar su código, cómo tener sentido fuera de los informes de perfiladores, y cómo tomar decisiones de optimización basadas en ellos. Usted se asegurará de que el código lento no se arrastra de nuevo en su aplicación Ruby escribiendo pruebas de rendimiento, y usted aprenderá la manera correcta de referencia Ruby. Y por último, te sumergirás en los internos de Ruby para entender realmente por qué la colección de basura hace que Ruby sea tan lento, y cómo puedes sintonizarlo. Lo que necesitas:Alguna versión de Ruby. El consejo de este libro se aplica a todas las versiones modernas de Ruby de 1.9 a 2.2. 80% del material también será útil para los usuarios de Ruby 1.8 heredados, y también hay 1,8 consejos específicos.

title: Computer Science Programming Basics in Ruby
description:
If you know basic high-school math, you can quickly learn and apply the core concepts of computer science with this concise, hands-on book. Led by a team of experts, you’ll quickly understand the difference between computer science and computer programming, and you’ll learn how algorithms help you solve computing problems.

Each chapter builds on material introduced earlier in the book, so you can master one core building block before moving on to the next. You’ll explore fundamental topics such as loops, arrays, objects, and classes, using the easy-to-learn Ruby programming language. Then you’ll put everything together in the last chapter by programming a simple game of tic-tac-toe.

Learn how to write algorithms to solve real-world problems
Understand the basics of computer architecture
Examine the basic tools of a programming language
Explore sequential, conditional, and loop programming structures
Understand how the array data structure organizes storage
Use searching techniques and comparison-based sorting algorithms
Learn about objects, including how to build your own
Discover how objects can be created from other objects
Manipulate files and use their data in your software

Aprende a escribir algoritmos para resolver problemas del mundo real

Examinar las herramientas básicas de un lenguaje de programación

Use técnicas de búsqueda y algoritmos de clasificación basados en comparación
Aprender sobre objetos, incluyendo cómo construir su propio
Descubra cómo se pueden crear objetos de otros objetos
Manipular archivos y utilizar sus datos en su software

title: Python Web Development with Sanic

Python Web Development with Sanic is a comprehensive guide for learning Sanic, a powerful and scalable Python web framework. With this book, you'll explore the key concepts and features of Sanic and gain the skills to develop high-performance web applications that can handle demanding workloads.

Gain a deep understanding of Sanic and how it operates in comparison to other frameworks such as Django or Flask.
Learn how to build scalable and performant web applications using the reactive nature of asynchronous programming.
Master the techniques for securely and efficiently organizing application architecture using Sanic.
Explore advanced topics in Sanic, such as background tasks, middleware, and GraphQL APIs.
Build, test, and deploy a complete example of a modern Sanic web application, covering real-world best practices.

Author(s)

Stephen Sadowski and Adam Hopkins are seasoned Python developers with extensive experience in building robust web applications. Adam, as one of the creators of the Sanic framework, brings unique insights into its architecture and philosophy. Together, they aim to provide a thorough and practical guide to mastering Sanic.

Who is it for?

If you're a Python web developer interested in advancing your skills in building scalable and high-performance applications, this book is for you. Readers with a working knowledge of Python and familiarity with frameworks like Django or Flask will find this book especially beneficial. The book is also helpful for developers looking to better understand asynchronous programming and adapt to modern web development practices. Additionally, if you enjoy practical examples and step-by-step guidance, you'll appreciate this resource.

title: Think Complexity
description: Expand your Python skills by working with data structures and algorithms in a refreshing context—through an eye-opening exploration of complexity science. Whether you’re an intermediate-level Python programmer or a student of computational modeling, you’ll delve into examples of complex systems through a series of exercises, case studies, and easy-to-understand explanations.

title: Hands-On High Performance Programming with Qt 5
description:

Focused on concurrency, parallel programming, and memory management, it equips you with essential skills to build efficient, optimized, and cutting-edge cross-platform applications.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to use performance analysis tools to improve application efficiency.
Understand and implement memory management techniques for optimal resource use.
Master concurrency and multithreading to build responsive Qt applications.
Optimize GUI design and networking performance in Qt applications.
Get insights into fine-tuning applications for embedded and mobile platforms.

Author(s)

Marek Krajewski is a seasoned software developer with extensive experience in Qt development and performance optimization. With his in-depth understanding of C++ and various modern programming paradigms, Marek's approach to explaining complex topics is practical and accessible. He focuses on delivering clear, actionable strategies for developing high-quality software.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for Qt developers aiming to refine their programming skills and build high-performance applications. Readers should have basic knowledge of Qt and C++ and want to explore advanced topics like performance optimization, concurrency, and efficient memory usage. If you are keen on creating responsive and optimized cross-platform applications with Qt, this book is tailored for you.

title: Think Python
description: If you want to learn how to program, working with Python is an excellent way to start. This hands-on guide takes you through the language one step at a time, beginning with basic programming concepts before moving on to functions, recursion, data structures, and object-oriented design. Through exercises in each chapter, you’ll try out programming concepts as you learn them.

title: Ruby Best Practices
description:
How do you write truly elegant code with Ruby? Ruby Best Practices is for programmers who want to use Ruby as experienced Rubyists do. Written by the developer of the Ruby project Prawn, this concise book explains how to design beautiful APIs and domain-specific languages with Ruby, as well as how to work with functional programming ideas and techniques that can simplify your code and make you more productive. You'll learn how to write code that's readable, expressive, and much more. Ruby Best Practices will help you:

Understand the secret powers unlocked by Ruby's code blocks
Learn how to bend Ruby code without breaking it, such as mixing in modules on the fly
Discover the ins and outs of testing and debugging, and how to design for testability
Learn to write faster code by keeping things simple
Develop strategies for text processing and file management, including regular expressions
Understand how and why things can go wrong
Reduce cultural barriers by leveraging Ruby's multilingual capabilities

This book also offers you comprehensive chapters on driving code through tests, designing APIs, and project maintenance. Learn how to make the most of this rich, beautiful language with Ruby Best Practices.

title: Hands-On Cryptography with Python
description:
"Hands-On Cryptography with Python" teaches you how to secure information through encryption using Python, explaining important cryptographic methods like AES, SHA, and RSA. You'll also explore cryptographic attacks and evaluate data security in a clear and hands-on way.

What this Book will help me do

Master data encryption and decryption techniques using Python.
Discover common cryptography methods and understand their strengths and weaknesses.
Learn about hashing, create hashes, and understand their role in cryptography.
Gain the ability to implement AES, SHA, and RSA encryption standards.
Understand common flaws in encryption techniques and how to avoid them.

Author(s)

Samuel Bowne is an expert in information security with years of experience teaching security concepts through practical approaches. He specializes in simplifying complex technical topics for diverse audiences. His instructional style combines clarity with engaging hands-on exercises.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for security professionals, Python programmers, and enthusiasts interested in learning about cryptography and encryption. It caters to beginners who have some programming foundations and want to enhance their knowledge in secure data handling. It is also suitable for experienced security analysts looking to refresh or expand on cryptographic methods.

title: Beginning Programming with Python For Dummies
description:
Learn Python—the fun and easy way—and get in the programming game today!

Python is one of the fastest growing programming languages, and no wonder. It requires three to five times less time than developing in Java, is a great building block for learning both procedural and object-oriented programming concepts, and is an ideal language for data analysis. Beginning Programming with Python For Dummies is the perfect guide to this dynamic and powerful programming language—even if you've never coded before! Author John Paul Mueller draws on his vast programming knowledge and experience to guide you step-by-step through the syntax and logic of programming with Python and provides several real-world programming examples to give you hands-on experience trying out what you've learned.

Provides a solid understanding of basic computer programming concepts and helps familiarize you with syntax and logic

Explains the fundamentals of procedural and object-oriented programming

Shows how Python is being used for data analysis and other applications

Includes short, practical programming samples to apply your skills to real-world programming scenarios

Whether you've never written a line of code or are just trying to pick up Python, there's nothing to fear with the fun and friendly Beginning Programming with Python For Dummies leading the way.

title: Programming in Python 3: A Complete Introduction to the Python Language
description:
Python 3 is the best version of the language yet: It is more powerful, convenient, consistent, and expressive than ever before. Now, leading Python programmer Mark Summerfield demonstrates how to write code that takes full advantage of Python 3’s features and idioms. The first book written from a completely “Python 3” viewpoint, Programming in Python 3 brings together all the knowledge you need to write any program, use any standard or third-party Python 3 library, and create new library modules of your own.

Summerfield draws on his many years of Python experience to share deep insights into Python 3 development you won’t find anywhere else. He begins by illuminating Python’s “beautiful heart”: the eight key elements of Python you need to write robust, high-performance programs. Building on these core elements, he introduces new topics designed to strengthen your practical expertise–one concept and hands-on example at a time. This book’s coverage includes

Developing in Python using procedural, object-oriented, and functional programming paradigms

Creating custom packages and modules

Writing and reading binary, text, and XML files, including optional compression, random access, and text and XML parsing

Leveraging advanced data types, collections, control structures, and functions

Spreading program workloads across multiple processes and threads

Programming SQL databases and key-value DBM files

Utilizing Python’s regular expression mini-language and module

Building usable, efficient, GUI-based applications

Advanced programming techniques, including generators, function and class decorators, context managers, descriptors, abstract base classes, metaclasses, and more

Programming in Python 3serves as both tutorial and language reference, and it is accompanied by extensive downloadable example code–all of it tested with the final version of Python 3 on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X.
