¿Su código Rails sufre de hinchazón, hervidor o inexactitud? Cure estos problemas con la aplicación regular del desarrollo impulsado por los ensayos. Usted utilizará Rails 5.1, Minitest 5, y RSpec 3.6, así como bibliotecas populares de pruebas tales como fábrica girl y Cucumber. Las actualizaciones incluyen pruebas de sistema Rails 5.1 e integración de Webpack. Haga lo que el médico ordenó para que sus aplicaciones se sientan mejor. Los efectos secundarios pueden incluir mejor código, menos errores y desarrolladores más felices.

Su aplicación Ruby on Rails está enferma. Los plazos están temblando, pero cada vez que haces el menor cambio al código, algo más se rompe. Nadie recuerda lo que se suponía que debía hacer esa pieza de código difícil, y nadie puede decir lo que realmente hace. Además, tiene bichos. Usted necesita desarrollo impulsado por pruebas: un proceso para mejorar el diseño, mantenimiento y viabilidad a largo plazo del software.

Con ejemplos de código práctico y discusión de por qué funciona la prueba, este libro comienza con las características más básicas entregadas como parte del núcleo de Ruby en Rails. Una vez que haya integrado esas características en su práctica de codificación, trabaje con herramientas populares de prueba de terceros como RSpec, Jasmine, Cucumber y factory girl. Prueba las partes componentes de una aplicación Rails, incluyendo la lógica del modelo back-end y la lógica de la pantalla frontal. Con ejemplos de Rails, utilice pruebas para permitir que su código responda mejor al cambio futuro. Además, vea cómo manejar situaciones de prueba del mundo real.

Esta nueva edición ha sido actualizada en Rails 5.1 y RSpec 3.6 y contiene una cobertura completa de nuevas características de Rails, incluyendo pruebas de sistema y la configuración de JavaScript basada en Webpack.

Lo que necesitas:

Ruby 2.4, Rails 5.1

title: Python Geospatial Development - Third Edition
description:
Immerse yourself in geospatial development with Python in this comprehensive guide. You will learn how to interact with geospatial data, perform calculations, and create mapping applications. By mastering these skills, you will be capable of building advanced geospatial projects and utilities.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and work with geospatial data in both vector and raster formats using Python.
Perform geospatial calculations, including those for projections and coordinate systems.
Create interactive web-based maps and integrate geospatial data into web applications.
Utilize Python libraries and frameworks, such as GeoDjango, for geospatial development.
Efficiently store and access geospatial information in spatial databases for large projects.

Author(s)

None Westra, with extensive experience in geospatial development and Python programming, focuses on practical applications of geospatial technology through hands-on examples. With a passion for teaching complex topics in an accessible way, Westra brings valuable insights to Python programmers exploring the geospatial field.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for developers with a foundational knowledge of Python who aim to enhance their expertise by incorporating geospatial tools and concepts into their projects. Whether creating web maps or performing spatial analysis, you will find valuable insights here. It's perfect for anyone excited about learning how to handle geospatial data and functionalities. Gain the skills to lead your geospatial development endeavors.

Entender y trabajar con datos geoespaciales en formatos vectoriales y de raster utilizando Python.

title: Building Serverless Microservices in Python
description:
Serverless computing with Python allows developers to build scalable, efficient microservices with reduced operational overhead. In 'Building Serverless Microservices in Python,' you will learn all about serverless architectures, how to create microservices with AWS, and how to secure, deploy, and test them effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the advantages of serverless microservices over traditional architectures.
Develop and deploy serverless applications using AWS services and Python.
Learn techniques for testing serverless architectures for bug-free deployment.
Secure your serverless applications to protect data and user access.
Build a complete serverless data API ready to scale for production use.

Author(s)

Takashi Freeman has extensive experience in building cloud-based systems and serverless architectures. As a Python developer with years of hands-on experience, Freeman brings a practical approach to learning how to design and deploy serverless applications. His teaching style bridges theory and practice, making complex topics accessible.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for Python developers looking to expand their skills into serverless architecture using AWS. If you are familiar with Python basics and eager to learn about building, deploying, and testing serverless microservices, then this guide is tailored for you. It suits professionals aiming to enhance their expertise in scalable, cloud-native applications. Ideal for developers, architects, and DevOps enthusiasts.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprenda las ventajas de los microservicios sin servidor sobre las arquitecturas tradicionales.
Desarrollar e implementar aplicaciones sin servidor utilizando servicios AWS y Python.

title: Learning Ruby
description:
You don't have to know everything about a car to drive one, and you don't need to know everything about Ruby to start programming with it. Written for both experienced and new programmers alike, Learning Ruby is a just-get-in-and-drive book -- a hands-on tutorial that offers lots of Ruby programs and lets you know how and why they work, just enough to get you rolling down the road.Interest in Ruby stems from the popularity of Rails, the web development framework that's attracting new devotees and refugees from Java and PHP. But there are plenty of other uses for this versatile language. The best way to learn is to just try the code! You'll find examples on nearly every page of this book that you can imitate and hack. Briefly, this book:

Outlines many of the most important features of Ruby
Demonstrates how to use conditionals, and how to manipulate strings in Ruby. Includes a section on regular expressions
Describes how to use operators, basic math, functions from the Math module, rational numbers, etc.
Talks you through Ruby arrays, and demonstrates hashes in detail
Explains how to process files with Ruby
Discusses Ruby classes and modules (mixins) in detail, including a brief introduction to object-oriented programming (OOP)
Introduces processing XML, the Tk toolkit, RubyGems, reflection, RDoc, embedded Ruby, metaprogramming, exception handling, and other topics
Acquaints you with some of the essentials of Rails, and includes a short Rails tutorial.
Each chapter concludes with a set of review questions, and appendices provide you with a glossary of terms related to Ruby programming, plus reference material from the book in one convenient location. If you want to take Ruby out for a drive, Learning Ruby holds the keys.

El interés en Ruby proviene de la popularidad de Rails, el marco de desarrollo web que atrae a nuevos devotos y refugiados de Java y PHP. Pero hay muchos otros usos para este lenguaje versátil. Demuestra cómo usar condicionales y cómo manipular cadenas en Ruby. Incluye una sección sobre expresiones regulares
Describe cómo utilizar operadores, matemáticas básicas, funciones del módulo de Matemáticas, números racionales, etc.
Te habla a través de los arrays Ruby, y demuestra hashes en detalle
Explica cómo procesar archivos con Ruby
Discusses Clases y módulos Ruby (mixins) en detalle, incluyendo una breve introducción a la programación orientada hacia objetos (OOP)
Presenta procesamiento XML, el kit de herramientas Tk, RubyGems, reflexión, RDoc, Ruby incrustado, metaprogramación, manejo de excepción y otros temas
Te familiariza con algunos de los elementos esenciales de Rails, e incluye un breve tutorial de Rails.
Cada capítulo concluye con un conjunto de preguntas de revisión, y los apéndices le proporcionan un glosario de términos relacionados con la programación de Ruby, más material de referencia del libro en una ubicación conveniente. Si quieres llevar a Ruby a una unidad, Aprender Ruby tiene las llaves.

title: Ruby in Practice
description:
Like Ruby itself, Ruby in Practice will make you more productive. The book shows you practical techniques and strategies for small projects and large-scale environments. A cookbook-style reference, it gives you concrete examples of systems integration, messaging, web development, and databases, all in a clear problem/ solution format.

Part 1 of the book concentrates on the Ruby way of developing software, especially how to use Ruby as a tool for integration. Part 2 talks about REST, Web services, asynchronous messaging, and deployment. In the last part, you'll discover how to manage all forms of data—from manipulating structured documents to identity management. Along the way you'll learn how to use Ruby to build new applications, solve more problems with less effort, integrate with your existing applications, and give new life to your legacy systems.

About the TechnologyAbout the BookWhat's Inside
Using Rails to build REST services
Automate communication between components and systems
Securely store and authenticate passwords
Index and query any set of documents
Generate scheduled reports in Ruport
About the ReaderAbout the Authors

title: Mastering Python for Data Science
description:
"Mastering Python for Data Science" is your comprehensive guide to unlocking the full potential of Python in the realm of data science. This book walks you through the essential concepts, techniques, and libraries you'll need to manage data, perform analyses, and derive actionable insights. It emphasizes practical applications and hands-on learning, bridging the gap between theory and implementation.

What this Book will help me do

Master data manipulation techniques using Python for effective data preprocessing.
Develop a deep understanding of linear and logistic regression for predictive modeling.
Learn to create detailed and insightful visualizations using tools like Matplotlib.
Discover advanced machine learning techniques, such as ensemble methods and collaborative filtering.
Work with big data technologies and text mining to handle and analyze large-scale unstructured data.

Author(s)

Samir Madhavan is a seasoned data science educator and practitioner with years of experience applying Python to solve complex data challenges. His deep understanding of Python and passion for teaching have made him a sought-after expert in the data science community. In his writing, Samir combines clarity with a focus on real-world applications, ensuring readers gain skills they can immediately apply.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for Python developers eager to expand into data science, as well as aspiring data scientists looking to apply Python to real-world problems. A basic understanding of Python and familiarity with data science is recommended. Readers will gain the tools and knowledge needed to excel in a data-driven world, applying advanced techniques and handling real-world challenges.
translatedDescription:
"Mastering Python for Data Science" es su guía integral para desbloquear todo el potencial de Python en el ámbito de la ciencia de datos. Este libro te lleva a través de los conceptos, técnicas y bibliotecas esenciales que necesitarás para gestionar datos, realizar análisis y obtener información práctica. Pone de relieve las aplicaciones prácticas y el aprendizaje práctico, que abren la brecha entre la teoría y la aplicación.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Técnicas maestras de manipulación de datos usando Python para el procesamiento eficaz de datos.
Desarrollar una profunda comprensión de la regresión lineal y logística para el modelado predictivo.
Aprende a crear visualizaciones detalladas y perspicaces usando herramientas como Matplotlib.
Descubra técnicas avanzadas de aprendizaje automático, como métodos de ensemble y filtrado colaborativo.
Trabajar con grandes tecnologías de datos y minería de texto para manejar y analizar datos no estructurados a gran escala.

Autor(s)

Samir Madhavan es un educador de ciencias de datos experimentado y practicante con años de experiencia aplicando Python para resolver problemas complejos de datos. Su profunda comprensión de Python y pasión por la enseñanza le han convertido en un experto buscado en la comunidad científica de datos. En su escritura, Samir combina claridad con un enfoque en aplicaciones reales, asegurando que los lectores obtengan habilidades que pueden aplicar inmediatamente.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para los desarrolladores de Python deseosos de expandirse en la ciencia de datos, así como aspirantes a científicos de datos que buscan aplicar Python a problemas del mundo real. Se recomienda una comprensión básica de Python y familiaridad con la ciencia de datos. Los lectores ganarán las herramientas y los conocimientos necesarios para sobresalir en un mundo basado en datos, aplicando técnicas avanzadas y manejando desafíos del mundo real.

title: Programming Techniques Through C: A Beginner's Companion
description:
A hands-on book on rudiments of programming, Programming Techniques through C: A Beginner's Companion teaches you the techniques of solving problems from simpler ones like "finding out the area of a triangle" to more involved ones like "sorting and searching".

The visual approach to solve problems in a step-by-step manner through flowcharts makes it easy for the beginners to solve problems and write programs using the C programming language. The emphasis is on problem solving procedures rather than learning a language.
translatedDescription:
Un libro práctico sobre rudimentos de programación, Técnicas de programación a través de C: El Compañero de un principiante te enseña las técnicas de resolver problemas de los más simples como "averiguar el área de un triángulo" a los más involucrados como "agrupar y buscar".

El enfoque visual para resolver problemas de manera paso a paso a través de diagramas de flujo hace fácil para los principiantes resolver problemas y escribir programas utilizando el lenguaje de programación C. El énfasis es en los procedimientos de solución de problemas en lugar de aprender un idioma.

title: Emerging Programming Languages
description:
C++, Java, Python, and other established programming languages may yet be with us for a long time, but our current software development landscape has given rise to new languages that benefit from the lessons learned over decades of programming. In this report, you’ll examine six of the fastest-growing programming languages: Crystal, Elixir, Elm, Julia, Kotlin, and Rust.

The O’Reilly editorial team covers the issues that drive modern language development and provides an overview of each language’s origins, features, usage, and trends. You’ll learn the answers to several key questions: Why are these languages important to software developers and the programming community? What makes them good at challenging other, more established languages? What problems do they solve for programmers and software architects?

This report examines:

Issues addressed by these modern languages such as concurrency, visibility, environment, syntax, robustness, data types, and functions
The purpose that motivated each language’s creation, as well as choices and trade-offs made in the process
Unique features that each language offers to programmers
What their rapid rise reveals about the shifting ecosystem
translatedDescription:
C+++, Java, Python y otros lenguajes de programación establecidos pueden estar todavía con nosotros durante mucho tiempo, pero nuestro panorama actual de desarrollo de software ha dado lugar a nuevos idiomas que se benefician de las lecciones aprendidas durante décadas de programación. En este informe se examinarán seis de los lenguajes de programación más rápidos: Crystal, Elixir, Elm, Julia, Kotlin y Rust.

El equipo editorial O’Reilly cubre los temas que impulsan el desarrollo del lenguaje moderno y ofrece una visión general de los orígenes, características, uso y tendencias de cada idioma. Usted aprenderá las respuestas a varias preguntas clave: ¿Por qué son estos idiomas importantes para los desarrolladores de software y la comunidad de programación? ¿Qué los hace buenos para desafiar otros idiomas más establecidos? ¿Qué problemas resuelven para programadores y arquitectos de software?

El presente informe examina:

Cuestiones abordadas por estos lenguajes modernos, como la concurrencia, la visibilidad, el medio ambiente, la sintaxis, la robustez, los tipos de datos y las funciones
El propósito que motivó la creación de cada idioma, así como las opciones y compensaciones hechas en el proceso
Características únicas que cada idioma ofrece a los programadores
Lo que su rápido ascenso revela sobre el ecosistema cambiante

description: WebAssembly (WASM) is a collection of standards for facilitating safe, fast, portable code, deployable into almost any modern runtime environment—browser, server, cloud, edge, embedded. Estos atajos le permitirán poner WASM en acción y experimentar cómo podría impactar cada aspecto de cómo construimos software.

title: Ruby by Example
description:
There may be no better way to learn how to program than by dissecting real, representative examples written in your language of choice. Ruby by Example analyzes a series of Ruby scripts, examining how the code works, explaining the concepts it illustrates, and showing how to modify it to suit your needs. Baird's examples demonstrate key features of the language (such as inheritance, encapsulation, higher-order functions, and recursion), while simultaneously solving difficult problems (such as validating XML, creating a bilingual program, and creating command-line interfaces). Each chapter builds upon the previous, and each key concept is highlighted in the margin to make it easier for you to navigate the book.

You'll learn how to:

Use the interactive Ruby shell (irb) to learn key features of the language

Extend Ruby using RubyGems, the Ruby package manager

Create numerical utilities, as well as utilities that process and analyze HTML/XML

Implement purely functional and metaprogramming techniques to save time and effort

Optimize, profile, and test your code to make sure that it not only does its job, but does it well

Create web applications using Rails

Ruby is the fastest growing programming language today, and for good reason: Its elegant syntax and readable code make for prolific and happy programmers. But it can be difficult to understand and implement without a little help. Ruby by Example shows you how to take advantage of Ruby as you explore Ruby's fundamental concepts in action.
translatedDescription:
Puede que no haya mejor manera de aprender a programar que diseccionando ejemplos reales y representativos escritos en su idioma de elección. Ruby by Ejemplo analiza una serie de scripts Ruby, examinando cómo funciona el código, explicando los conceptos que ilustra y mostrando cómo modificarlo para satisfacer sus necesidades. Los ejemplos de Baird demuestran características clave del lenguaje (como la herencia, la encapsulación, funciones de orden superior y recurrencia), al tiempo que resuelven problemas difíciles (como validar XML, crear un programa bilingüe y crear interfaces de línea de comandos). Cada capítulo se basa en lo anterior, y cada concepto clave se destaca en el margen para que sea más fácil para usted navegar el libro.

Aprenderás a:

Utilice el shell interactivo de Ruby (irb) para aprender características clave del idioma

Extend Ruby utilizando RubyGems, el administrador del paquete Ruby

Crear utilidades numéricas, así como utilidades que procesan y analizan HTML/XML

Implementar técnicas puramente funcionales y metaprogramadoras para ahorrar tiempo y esfuerzo

Optimize, profile, y probar su código para asegurarse de que no sólo hace su trabajo, pero lo hace bien

Crear aplicaciones web usando Rails

Ruby es el lenguaje de programación de más rápido crecimiento hoy, y por buena razón: Su elegante sintaxis y código legible hacen para los programadores prolíficos y felices. Pero puede ser difícil entender e implementar sin un poco de ayuda. Ruby by Ejemplo te muestra cómo aprovechar a Ruby mientras exploras los conceptos fundamentales de Ruby en acción.

title: Rituals for Work
description:
Experience the transformative power of creative rituals in the workplace

Rituals for Work shows us how creative rituals can make our personal and business lives more meaningful and rewarding. Rituals are powerful tools: they reinforce good habits, motivate personal and professional achievement, create a common bond between co-workers and build shared values; they can transform an organization’s culture and provide a foundation to achieve common goals. Focusing on real-world examples, this book takes a practical approach to the power and benefits of workplace rituals. This insightful guide presents 50 creative rituals, from business and management to design and personal development. Specific case studies highlight the use of rituals and their positive impact to real-world organizations, while vivid visuals allow us to feel their energy and emotion.

A ritual is only effective when its purpose is clearly defined. This book goes beyond simple analysis to provide actual recipes for individual rituals designed to promote specific habits, change negative behaviors, and instill values. Each ritual can be adapted to achieve a multitude of goals and tailored to fit your organization or team’s specific needs.

●      Change behaviors, form positive habits, and assign meaning to shared goals

●      Build shared values, foster innovation, and encourage strong teamwork

●      Deal with conflicts effectively and engage others to work on resolutions

●      Learn the fundamental concepts of ritual-building and share your knowledge with your team

An informative and inspirational resource for executives, managers, team leaders, and employees of every level, Rituals for Work provides a blueprint for building a culture of engagement, innovation, and shared purpose for organizations of all sizes, across industries.
translatedDescription:
Experimente el poder transformador de los rituales creativos en el trabajo

Rituals for Work nos muestra cómo los rituales creativos pueden hacer nuestra vida personal y empresarial más significativa y gratificante. Los rituales son herramientas poderosas: refuerzan los buenos hábitos, motivan el logro personal y profesional, crean un vínculo común entre compañeros de trabajo y construyen valores compartidos; pueden transformar la cultura de una organización y proporcionar una base para alcanzar objetivos comunes. Centrándose en ejemplos reales, este libro toma un enfoque práctico del poder y los beneficios de los rituales laborales. Esta guía perspicaz presenta 50 rituales creativos, desde el negocio y la gestión hasta el diseño y el desarrollo personal. Estudios de casos específicos resaltan el uso de rituales y su impacto positivo a las organizaciones del mundo real, mientras que visuales vívidas nos permiten sentir su energía y emoción.

Un ritual sólo es eficaz cuando su propósito está claramente definido. So what is it that makes some people cope with these adverse situations so well? It's not about what is happening to you, but how you react to it. It's about your resilience.

Arming you with a personal toolkit to handle day to day challenges, and providing strategies for thriving in uncertain times Liggy shows you how to increase your 'bouncibility' and bounce back from whatever negative things life throws at you.

title: Learning Beaglebone Python Programming
description:
This book, 'Learning Beaglebone Python Programming', serves as an excellent resource for those delving into Beaglebone development. Through this guide, you will utilize Python to interact with hardware peripherals, create web-based user interfaces, and develop real-world projects. With step-by-step instructions, you'll transform ideas into functional, hands-on electronic applications. It's a practical guide for hobbyists and engineers alike.

What this Book will help me do

You will learn to control GPIO and other hardware pins programmatically using Python.
You will be able to implement PWM and ADC for precise motor and sensor applications.
You will gain skills in building interactive user interfaces for BeagleBone-based projects.
You will understand how to establish serial and network communications with external devices.
You will troubleshoot and complete hands-on projects involving real-world BeagleBone applications.

Author(s)

Alexander C Hiam is an experienced developer and engineer with a strong foundation in Python programming and embedded systems. With years of practice in guiding others through the principles of working with microcontrollers like the BeagleBone, Alexander emphasizes practical learning and hands-on experience. His approachable and technical style makes this book an essential guide for beginners and enthusiasts alike.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for engineers, students, and enthusiasts who are familiar with Python programming and wish to explore building applications on the BeagleBone platform. If you've ever wanted to connect your programming knowledge to real-world hardware projects, this book is for you. It covers topics from the basics to creating advanced, interactive applications. Whether you're starting out or advancing your skills, you'll find valuable content here.

A través de esta guía, utilizará Python para interactuar con periféricos de hardware, crear interfaces de usuario basadas en la web, y desarrollar proyectos en el mundo real. Con instrucciones paso a paso, transformarás las ideas en aplicaciones electrónicas funcionales y prácticas. Es una guía práctica para hobbyistas e ingenieros por igual.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Aprenderá a controlar GPIO y otros pines de hardware programáticamente usando Python.
Podrá implementar PWM y ADC para aplicaciones precisas de motores y sensores.
Usted ganará habilidades en la construcción de interfaces de usuario interactivas para proyectos basados en BeagleBone.
Usted comprenderá cómo establecer comunicaciones en serie y en red con dispositivos externos.
Usted resolverá problemas y completará proyectos prácticos con aplicaciones BeagleBone en el mundo real.

Autor(s)

Alexander C Hiam es un desarrollador e ingeniero experimentado con una fuerte fundación en la programación de Python y sistemas integrados. Con años de práctica en guiar a otros a través de los principios de trabajar con microcontroladores como el BeagleBone, Alexander enfatiza el aprendizaje práctico y la experiencia práctica. Su estilo accesible y técnico hace de este libro una guía esencial para principiantes y entusiastas por igual.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está diseñado para ingenieros, estudiantes y entusiastas que están familiarizados con la programación de Python y desean explorar aplicaciones de construcción en la plataforma BeagleBone. Si alguna vez has querido conectar tu conocimiento de programación a proyectos de hardware del mundo real, este libro es para ti. Se trata de temas desde lo básico a la creación de aplicaciones avanzadas e interactivas. Ya sea que estés empezando o promoviendo tus habilidades, encontrarás contenido valioso aquí.

title: Learning Core Data for iOS with Swift: A Hands-On Guide to Building Core Data Applications, Second Edition
description:
Get Started Fast with Core Data App Development Using iOS 9, Swift, and Xcode 7

Core Data is a remarkably mature, stable, and fast platform for data access, and Swift is a world-class language for applying it. Now, there’s a complete guide to using Core Data and Swift together in production apps. Tim Roadley shows you how to gain the benefits of a relational database without writing SQL queries, so you can get more done faster, with less coding.

This book fully reflects Apple’s latest iOS 9 platform innovations and teaches Core Data entirely with Swift examples. It guides you step-by-step through creating a modern data-driven iOS app that fully integrates iCloud via CloudKit for public data sharing.

Roadley introduces up-to-date patterns and best practices designed to overcome the frustrations of Core Data development. Each chapter builds on the last, introducing new topics in the order you’ll implement them and extending your skills simply and intuitively.

Each chapter offers downloadable project code, along with exercises to help you explore even further, either as a self-learner or a student in an iOS development course. Roadley even shows how to build helper classes that simplify reuse of his example code.

If you’re an experienced iOS developer, here are all the Swift skills and resources you need to integrate data into any app—quickly, easily, and painlessly.

Coverage includes

Understanding what Core Data is and what it can (and can’t) do

Configuring basic managed object models, and choosing data types

Expanding data models without introducing errors

Using relationships and entity inheritance to unlock more power

Delivering memory-efficient, high performance table views

Enabling users to easily modify managed object attributes

Generating persistent stores of preloaded default data

Using Deep Copy to copy objects and relationships between persistent stores

Optimizing performance by eliminating bottlenecks and offloading intensive tasks to the background

Implementing efficient search

Integrating diverse iCloud accounts and preferences

Mastering advanced iCloud integration, including entity-level seeding and unique object de-dupe

Leveraging public CloudKit databases to sync data across users with different iCloud accounts

About the Website

All code samples are available for download at timroadley.com.

title: A Safe Place for Dangerous Truths
description:
No more "checking for feet." This illuminating guide gets people to tell the truth at the meeting--not in the bathroom afterwards.

Almost everybody does it--lie, that is. In one recent survey 93% of people admitted to lying regularly at work! Why? Because it's safer than telling the truth.

Sadly, organizations cannot succeed in this poisonous world of half-truths, strategic omissions, and doctored information. To function optimally, businesses must create an environment where people feel free to tell the truth, no matter how disturbing. Only then can organizations unleash the responsiveness, creativity, and enthusiasm necessary to achieve their goals.

This unique book shows how, using the formal process of "dialogue," such a place can be built. In a lively discussion, the author shows managers how to use this technique to encourage truth-telling by reducing fear, prompting self-examination, and opening minds * build trust where suspicion and cynicism held sway * inspire individuals to think and learn as a group * help groups talk through tough issues and move to collaborative action.
translatedDescription:
No más "controlando pies". Esta guía iluminadora hace que la gente diga la verdad en la reunión, no en el baño después.

Casi todo el mundo lo hace. En una encuesta reciente el 93% de las personas admitidas a mentir regularmente en el trabajo! ¿Por qué? Porque es más seguro que decir la verdad.

Tristemente, las organizaciones no pueden tener éxito en este mundo venenoso de semiverdades, omisiones estratégicas e información doctorada. Para funcionar de forma óptima, las empresas deben crear un entorno donde las personas se sientan libres de decir la verdad, no importa cuán perturbadora. Sólo entonces las organizaciones pueden desencadenar la capacidad de respuesta, creatividad y entusiasmo necesarios para alcanzar sus objetivos.

Este libro único muestra cómo, utilizando el proceso formal de "dialogo", tal lugar se puede construir. En un debate animado, el autor muestra a los gerentes cómo utilizar esta técnica para fomentar la narración de la verdad reduciendo el miedo, impulsando la autoexaminación y abriendo mentes * crear confianza donde la sospecha y el cinismo se mantenían en marcha * inspirar a los individuos a pensar y aprender como grupo * grupos de ayuda hablar a través de temas difíciles y pasar a la acción colaborativa.

title: Professional CodeIgniter®
description: If you're a PHP developer, you can build Rails-like applications without learning a new language by following the hands-on tutorials in Professional CodeIgniter. In this book, find an overview of MVC and agile technologies, model and schema for products, helpers and libraries, Ajax and Scriptaculous, and explanations of the creation of applications like content management, blogs, and forums. Follow the step-by-step instructions for building and perfecting each application with CodeIgniter, and you will learn how to avoid everyday problems that other reference manuals don't address.

En este libro encontrará una visión general de las tecnologías MVC y ágiles, modelo y esquema para productos, ayudantes y bibliotecas, Ajax y Scriptaculous, y explicaciones de la creación de aplicaciones como gestión de contenidos, blogs y foros. Siga las instrucciones paso a paso para construir y perfeccionar cada aplicación con CodeIgniter, y aprenderá a evitar problemas cotidianos que otros manuales de referencia no abordan.

title: Understanding Action Learning
description:
As much as adult learners can absorb in a classroom, they learn and retain a lot more on the job. Action Learning, or AL, can be based on any of several different schools of thought, and there is much debate as to which is ideal.

The authors advocate tailoring the best attributes of each approach to the specific purpose and the learning environment. Drawing on theory from Self-Directed Learning, Learning from Experience, and Transformative Learning, Understanding Action Learning enables the reader to make an informed decision about which approach or combination to use in his or her organization, and provides:

* a theoretical model that explains the different approaches to AL, and a framework for identifying which approach to use* a focus on co-design in creating Action Learning programs* practical tools, assessments, and exercises* illuminating stories and case studies from the field

Combining top-shelf research with real-world experience, Understanding Action Learning is a crucial resource for adult educators everywhere.
translatedDescription:
Tanto como los estudiantes adultos pueden absorber en un aula, aprenden y conservan mucho más en el trabajo. Aprendizaje de Acción, o AL, puede basarse en cualquiera de varias escuelas de pensamiento diferentes, y hay mucho debate en cuanto a cuál es ideal.

Los autores abogan por adaptar los mejores atributos de cada enfoque al propósito específico y al entorno de aprendizaje. Basándose en la teoría de Aprendizaje Auto-Directado, Aprendizaje de Experiencia y Aprendizaje Transformativo, Comprender Acción Aprendizaje permite al lector tomar una decisión informada sobre qué enfoque o combinación utilizar en su organización, y proporciona:

* un modelo teórico que explica los diferentes enfoques de AL, y un marco para identificar qué enfoque utilizar* un enfoque en la creación de programas de Aprendizaje de Acción* herramientas prácticas, evaluaciones y ejercicios* ilustrando historias y estudios de casos desde el campo

Combinando la investigación de la plataforma superior con la experiencia del mundo real, Understanding Action Learning es un recurso crucial para los educadores adultos en todas partes.

title: Sanitizing and Cleaning Up Text
description: Build your knowledge of Python with this Shortcuts collection. Focusing on common problems involving text manipulation, many of these tasks can be solved using built-in methods of strings. More complicated operations may require regular expressions or the creation of a full-fledged parser.

Centrarse en problemas comunes que implican la manipulación de texto, muchas de estas tareas se pueden resolver utilizando métodos integrados de cuerdas. Las operaciones más complicadas pueden requerir expresiones regulares o la creación de un parser completo.

title: Rails: Novice to Ninja, 3rd Edition
description:
Rails: Novice to Ninja is an easy-to-follow, practical and fun guide to Ruby on Rails for beginners. It covers all you need to get up and running, from installing Ruby, Rails and SQLite to building and deploying a fully-featured web application. The third edition of this book has been fully updated to cover Rails 5, the latest version of the framework.

Unlike other Rails books, this book doesn't assume that you are an experienced web developer, or that you've used Ruby before. An entire chapter is devoted to learning Ruby in a fun way, using the interactive Ruby console, so you can follow along at home. You'll be an accomplished Ruby programmer in no time! You'll then start using Rails to build a practical, working project: a Reddit-like social news application. As you'll build the app, you'll gain valuable experience of using Rails features such as user authentication, session cookies, and automated testing. The book finishes with chapters on debugging, benchmarking and deployment to a live web server.
translatedDescription:
Rails: Novice to Ninja es una guía fácil de seguir, práctica y divertida para Ruby en Rails para principiantes. Cubre todo lo que necesitas para levantarte y correr, desde la instalación de Ruby, Rails y SQLite para construir e implementar una aplicación web completamente ofrecida. La tercera edición de este libro ha sido completamente actualizada para cubrir Rails 5, la última versión del marco.

A diferencia de otros libros de Rails, este libro no asume que eres un desarrollador web experimentado, o que has utilizado Ruby antes. Un capítulo entero se dedica a aprender Ruby de una manera divertida, utilizando la consola interactiva Ruby, para que puedas seguir en casa. ¡Serás un programador de Ruby en poco tiempo! Luego empezarás a usar Rails para construir un proyecto práctico y de trabajo: una aplicación de noticias sociales similar a Reddit. A medida que construya la aplicación, obtendrá una valiosa experiencia de utilizar Rails funciones como autenticación de usuario, cookies de sesión y pruebas automatizadas. El libro termina con capítulos sobre depuración, benchmarking y despliegue en un servidor web en vivo.

title: Beginning Swift Programming
description:
Enter the Swift future of iOS and OS X programming

Beginning Swift Programming is your ideal starting point for creating Mac, iPhone, and iPad apps using Apple's new Swift programming language. Written by an experienced Apple developer and trainer, this comprehensive guide explains everything you need to know to jumpstart the creation of your app idea. Coverage includes data types, strings and characters, operators and functions, arrays and dictionaries, control flow, and looping, with expert guidance on classes, objects, class inheritance, closures, protocols, and generics. This succinct — yet complete — overview provides a detailed introduction to the core features of Swift.

Apple developed Swift to address the limitations of Objective-C, and add features found in more complex languages like Python. The results is simpler, cleaner, more expressive code with automatic memory management, functional programming patterns, and more, including built-in features that make Swift apps faster, scalable, and more secure. This book explains it all, helping developers master Apple's new language.

Become fluent with syntax that's easier to read and maintain

Understand inferred types for cleaner, less mistake-prone code

Learn the key features that make Swift more expressive than Objective-C

Learn the new optional types in Swift that make your code more resilient

Understand the key design patterns in iOS and Mac OS programming using protocols and delegates

Learn how to use generics to create highly reusable code

Learn the new access controls mechanism in Swift

Get up to speed quickly to remain relevant and ahead of the curve.

Ingrese el futuro Swift de la programación iOS y OS X

La cobertura incluye tipos de datos, cadenas y caracteres, operadores y funciones, arrays y diccionarios, flujo de control y bucle, con guía experta en clases, objetos, herencia de clase, cierres, protocolos y genéricos. Este resumen —aún completo— proporciona una introducción detallada a las características principales de Swift.

Apple desarrolló Swift para abordar las limitaciones de Objective-C, y añadir características encontradas en lenguajes más complejos como Python. Los resultados son un código más simple, más limpio, más expresivo con gestión automática de la memoria, patrones funcionales de programación, y más, incluyendo características incorporadas que hacen que las aplicaciones Swift sean más rápidas, escalables y más seguras. Este libro lo explica todo, ayudando a los desarrolladores a dominar el nuevo idioma de Apple.

Entender tipos inferidos para un código limpio, menos proclive a errores

Aprende las características clave que hacen que Swift sea más expresivo que Objective-C

Levántate rápidamente para seguir siendo relevante y por delante de la curva.

title: Learning Algorithms for Internet of Things: Applying Python Tools to Improve Data Collection Use for System Performance
description:
The advent of Internet of Things (IoT) has paved the way for sensing the environment and smartly responding. This can be further improved by enabling intelligence to the system with the support of machine learning and deep learning techniques. This book describes learning algorithms that can be applied to IoT-based, real-time applications and improve the utilization of data collected and the overall performance of the system.

Many societal challenges and problems can be resolved using a better amalgamation of IoT and learning algorithms. “Smartness” is the buzzword that is realized only with the help of learning algorithms. In addition, it supports researchers with code snippets that focus on the implementation and performance of learning algorithms on IoT based applications such as healthcare, agriculture, transportation, etc. These snippets include Python packages such as Scipy, Scikit-learn, Theano, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and more.

Learning Algorithms for Internet of Things provides you with an easier way to understand the purpose and application of learning algorithms on IoT.

What you’ll Learn

Supervised algorithms such as Regression and Classification.
Unsupervised algorithms, like K-means clustering, KNN, hierarchical clustering, principal component analysis, and more.
Artificial neural networks for IoT (architecture, feedback, feed-forward, unsupervised).
Convolutional neural networks for IoT (general, LeNet, AlexNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet, etc.).
Optimization methods, such as gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, Adagrad, AdaDelta, and IoT optimization.

Who This Book Is For

Students interested in learning algorithms and their implementations, as well as researchers in IoT looking to extend their work with learning algorithms
translatedDescription:
El advenimiento de Internet de las Cosas (IoT) ha allanado el camino para detectar el medio ambiente y responder inteligentemente. Esto puede mejorarse aún más permitiendo la inteligencia al sistema con el apoyo de técnicas de aprendizaje automático y de aprendizaje profundo. Este libro describe algoritmos de aprendizaje que pueden aplicarse a aplicaciones basadas en IoT en tiempo real y mejorar la utilización de los datos recopilados y el rendimiento general del sistema.

Muchos desafíos y problemas sociales se pueden resolver utilizando una mejor amalgama de IoT y algoritmos de aprendizaje. “Smartness” es la palabra de zumbido que se realiza sólo con la ayuda de aprender algoritmos. Además, apoya a investigadores con fragmentos de código que se centran en la implementación y el rendimiento de algoritmos de aprendizaje en aplicaciones basadas en IoT, como salud, agricultura, transporte, etc. Estos snippets incluyen paquetes de pitón como Scipy, Scikit-learn, Theano, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch y más.

Aprender algoritmos para Internet de las cosas le proporciona una manera más fácil de entender el propósito y la aplicación de algoritmos de aprendizaje en IoT.

Lo que aprenderás

algoritmos supervisados como regresión y clasificación.
algoritmos no supervisados, como K-means clustering, KNN, agrupación jerárquica, análisis de componentes principales, y más.
Redes neuronales artificiales para IoT (arquitectura, feedback, feed-forward, unsupervised).
Redes neuronales de IoT (general, LeNet, AlexNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet, etc.).
Métodos de optimización, como descenso de gradiente, descenso de gradiente estocástico, Adagrad, AdaDelta y optimización IoT.

Quién es este libro

Estudiantes interesados en aprender algoritmos y sus implementaciones, así como investigadores en IoT buscando ampliar su trabajo con algoritmos de aprendizaje

title: Learn Swift on the Mac: For OS X and iOS
description:
There's a new language in town. Swift is Apple's new, native, fast, and easy to learn programming language for iOS and OS X app development. It's their "Objective-C without the C". If you are an iOS developer or planning to become one, learning Swift is your #1 priority, and Learn Swift on the Mac tells you everything you need to get up to speed, well, swiftly.

You'll start with the Swift Playground and an introduction to object-oriented programming so you can immediately see Swift in action. You then learn about all of the key language features like functions and closures, classes, methods, extensions, and how Swift works just as well as Objective-C when it comes to easy memory management with ARC.

Finally you'll learn how to use Swift alongside Objective-C as well as with Core Data, and you'll learn how to put all of the pieces together with a health app using Apple's new HealthKit framework.
translatedDescription:
Hay un nuevo idioma en la ciudad. Swift es el nuevo, nativo, rápido y fácil de aprender lenguaje de programación para el desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS y OS X. Es su "Objetivo-C sin la C". Si eres un desarrollador de iOS o planeas convertirte en uno, aprender Swift es tu prioridad #1 y Aprende Swift en el Mac te dice todo lo que necesitas para acelerar, bien, rápidamente.

Comenzarás con el Swift Playground y una introducción a la programación orientada al objeto para que puedas ver inmediatamente Swift en acción. A continuación, usted aprende sobre todas las características clave del lenguaje como funciones y cierres, clases, métodos, extensiones, y cómo funciona Swift tan bien como Objetivo-C cuando se trata de una gestión de memoria fácil con ARC.

Finalmente aprenderás a usar Swift junto con Objective-C y con Core Data, y aprenderás a juntar todas las piezas con una aplicación de salud usando el nuevo marco de HealthKit de Apple.

title: The Yes/No Book
description:
How often do you say `YES’ to something, when you know you really wanted to say `NO’? You have the right and the power to choose. This book will show you how.

 

The Yes/No Book is about choice. It empowers you with the ability to know exactly when to say `YES’ and when to say `NO’, showing you how to handle both with no fear, no guilt and with confidence and self-assurance.

 

Empowered with the decision-making skills to know how and when to say `YES’ and `NO’ you will develop increasing control over your life. You will become more focussed, more productive, less stressed, more involved in doing the things you want to do and less in doing time-sapping chores that offer no benefit or joy.

title: Overworked and Overwhelmed: The Mindfulness Alternative
description:
Leverage mindful awareness and intention to achieve better outcomes

Overworked and Overwhelmed: The Mindfulness Alternative offers practical insights for the executive, manager or professional who feels like their RPM is maxed out in the red zone. By making the concepts and practices of mindfulness simple, practical and applicable, this book offers actionable hope for today's overworked and overwhelmed professional.

New research shows that the smartphone equipped professional is connected to work 72 hours a week. Forty eight percent of Americans report that their stress level is up and that the number one source of stress is the job pressure of a 24/7 world.

What's the alternative? Top leadership coach and educator Scott Eblin offers one in Overworked and Overwhelmed: The Mindfulness Alternative. While mindfulness is one of the "Top Ten Trends for 2014 and Beyond," many professionals think it's just too hard to give it a try. In this book, Eblin shows that mindfulness that makes a difference doesn't require meditating like a Buddhist monk.

Overworked and Overwhelmed is a handbook for more mindful work and living that offers:

"Must know" mindfulness basics that today's professional needs to thrive in a 24/7 world.

Inspiring examples of mindfulness in action from dozens of leaders ranging from a U.S. Coast Guard Commandant to the CEO of Hilton Worldwide.

A self assessment for readers to understand how they perform at their best.

Simple routines to reduce stress and sustain peak performance.

A personal planning framework for creating the outcomes that matter most at home, at work and in the community.

Even small increases in mindfulness can lead to big changes in productivity and quality of life for the overworked and overwhelmed professional. Overworked and Overwhelmed: The Mindfulness Alternative is a guide for doing just that.

title: Rails 5 Revealed
description:
This short early adopter book details both how you'll upgrade existing web applications from Rails 4.2 to 5 and how to create new applications in Rails 5. The headline features, Rails API and Action Cable are each looked at in detail, building small example projects to demonstrate how to build a JSON API and add real-time interactions in order to create a single-page application.

All the breaking changes are shown, along with how to fix your app to work with the new release. The improvements to ActiveRecord and the testing framework are fully detailed. After reading and using Rails 5 Revealed, you'll be poised to move forward with building your apps with the latest major release of Ruby on Rails.

What You'll Learn

Discover the new features in Rails 5 and how to upgrade your application from Rails 4.2

Gain knowledge about the changes to ActiveRecord

See the improvements to the Rails testing framework

Build API servers using Rails API

Create WebSocket applications using Action Cable

Who This Book Is For

Existing Rails developers who are looking to quickly get up to speed with the changes in the new Rails 5 framework.

Todos los cambios de ruptura se muestran, junto con cómo arreglar su aplicación para trabajar con la nueva versión. Las mejoras en ActiveRecord y el marco de pruebas son completamente detalladas. Después de leer y usar Rails 5 Revealed, estarás preparado para avanzar con la construcción de tus aplicaciones con la última versión importante de Ruby on Rails.

Lo que aprenderás

title: Beginning Ballerina Programming: From Novice to Professional
description:
Discover the Ballerina programming language for next-generation microservices and cloud-native application development. This book shows you that Ballerina is a cutting-edge programming language which incorporates many of the latest technological advancements in programming language theory. You'll learn variables and types, modules and functions, flow control, error handling, concurrency, I/O, cloud/network programming, persistence and data access, security and more. 

Additionally, Beginning Ballerina Programming introduces many foundation computer science topics along the way and doesn’t assume much prior knowledge. For example, when introducing transport-level security, you will get a brief introduction to public-key cryptography, how it is different from private-key cryptography, and why it is needed. This provides an added bonus for you to learn something new and general in computer science. 

After reading and using this book, you'll be proficientwith Ballerina and cloud-first programming and be able to apply these concepts and techniques to your next cloud application developments.  

What You'll Learn

·         Start programming with Ballerina 

·         Gain the basics of network communication and programming

·         Obtain a solid understanding of services/API development 

·         Effective use of concurrency in programming 

·         Learn the basics of information security and its applications

·         Persistent data storage and access

Who This Book Is For

Absolute beginners in computer programming: No prior experience with computer programming is expected. This can alsobe a reference book for experienced developers in other languages, who want to learn a modern programming language.

Aprenderás variables y tipos, módulos y funciones, control de flujo, manejo de errores, concurrencia, I/O, programación de cloud/network, persistencia y acceso a datos, seguridad y mucho más.

Además, Beginning Ballerina Programming introduce muchos temas de la informática de la fundación en el camino y no asume mucho conocimiento previo. Por ejemplo, al introducir la seguridad a nivel de transporte, obtendrá una breve introducción a la criptografía de clave pública, cómo es diferente de la criptografía de clave privada, y por qué es necesario. Esto proporciona un bono añadido para que usted aprenda algo nuevo y general en la ciencia informática.

Después de leer y utilizar este libro, usted será competente con Ballerina y la primera programación en la nube y será capaz de aplicar estos conceptos y técnicas a sus próximos desarrollos de aplicaciones en la nube.

Learn advanced Swift capabilities such as functional programming concepts for modern development
