• Internacionalización (I18N) y catálogos de mensajes en Ruby

• Operaciones en hashes, arrays y otras estructuras de datos como pilas, árboles y gráficos

• Trabajar con I/O general, archivos y objetos persistentes

• Cobertura de base incluyendo MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, DBI y más

• Técnicas específicas de Ruby en OOP y programación dinámica

• Interfaz gráfica en Ruby (Tk, GTK+, Fox y Qt)

• Trabajando con hilos Ruby para multitarea ligera

• Trabajando con archivos de imagen, PDF, YAML, XML, RSS y Atom

• Herramientas de desarrollo web incluyendo Rails, Nitro, Wee, IOWA y más

• Herramientas de desarrollo de Ruby como IDE, herramientas de documentación y más

Hal Fulton ha trabajado durante más de 15 años con diversas formas de Unix, incluyendo AIX, Solaris y Linux. Ha asistido a numerosas conferencias de Ruby y ha presentado presentaciones en varios de ellos, incluyendo la primera Conferencia Europea de Ruby.

Tiene dos grados en informática de la Universidad de Mississippi y enseñó ciencias informáticas durante cuatro años antes de mudarse a Austin, Texas para trabajar como contratista de varias empresas, incluyendo IBM Austin. Hal trabaja actualmente en Broadwing Communications en Austin, Texas, manteniendo un gran almacén de datos y aplicaciones de telecomunicaciones relacionadas, trabajando diariamente con C++, Oracle y, por supuesto, Ruby.

title: QT5 Blueprints

"Qt5 Blueprints" is an invaluable resource for developers aiming to design, build, and deploy cross-platform GUI projects with the powerful Qt 5 framework. Through real-world examples and practical guides, you will learn to create professional GUI applications effectively while leveraging the comprehensive features of Qt 5.

What this Book will help me do

Develop custom GUI applications using Qt's rich set of widgets and tools.
Master the Model-View-Controller architecture to improve app structure.
Learn techniques to integrate dynamic and static plugins into your applications.
Implement multi-threading to enhance your application's performance.
Enable internationalization in your projects to support multiple languages.

Author(s)

None Huang brings extensive experience in software development and GUI design to the readers of "Qt5 Blueprints." Their deep knowledge of the Qt framework is evident in the clear and practical examples presented in this book. With an approachable and detailed writing style, None has helped numerous developers bridge complex technical concepts with real-world application.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for programmers who seek to create professional cross-platform GUI applications using Qt 5. Readers should have a basic understanding of C programming and a foundation in Qt's functionalities to make the most of this guide. Whether you are looking to streamline your development process or enhance your applications with advanced Qt features, this book is for you. Both hobbyists and professionals will find practical value in its insights.

title: Sort Your Career Out
description:
The best investment you can make is in yourself and your career

Sort Your Career Out: And Make More Money is your go-to guide for building a career that you love. Dream jobs don't just come along: you need to make them happen. And this is the book that will show you how, from creating the ultimate career strategy to getting paid what you're really worth. (Hint: It's not just about changing the font on your resume!) With tips and guidance from two of today's top money and career experts, you'll learn how to change jobs, secure a promotion, ask for a pay rise and much, much more.

Whether you're preparing for a job interview or you're looking to make a radical change, Sort Your Career Out has the smart advice you need for earning more and winning at work. Inside you'll find practical activities that will help boost your bankability and take you further, faster. Along the way, you'll also follow diverse case studies from real employees: people who have been there, done that, and figured out the way forward.

Sort Your Career Out: And Make More Money unpacks everything you need to:

Establish your career mindset: define your purpose and unlock your skills and strengths
Set concrete goals and create new opportunities for yourself
Upskill with essential tips and templates for resumes, cover letters, interviews, networking, and more
Know when to take risks and how to handle setbacks like burnout and unemployment

It's time to discover more career flexibility and achieve your long-term goals. With this must-read handbook, you'll be ready to move up, move on, and feel more fulfilled with what you do every day.

title: The 6% Club
description:
NATIONAL BESTSELLERLearn the steps to build better habits and join the ranks of changemakers and goal achievers everywhere

In The 6% Club, The Change Doctor Michelle Rozen, PhD, teaches audiences and readers how to create and actually stick to new positive habits, unlocking the secret formula to the life, success, and happiness they've always dreamed of. The book was born from a recent study where Dr. Rozen surveyed 1,000 people who pledged to make a change in their lives, and, shockingly, only 6% had stuck to the change just a month later.

Dr. Rozen's powerful, uplifting, and actionable methods have been tested on countless event attendees from all types of background for over a decade. In this book, readers will learn how to:

Work out more, eat healthier, save more money, do better in business, or attain any other personal or professional goal
Make changes solo, or with another individual like a friend or partner
Stop making excuses, giving up, or putting it off—effortlessly

Based on science and written by one of the most sought-after motivational speakers on leadership and change, The 6% Club earns a well-deserved spot on the bookshelves of all individuals looking to make lasting changes in their personal and professional lives.

Trabajar más, comer más saludable, ahorrar más dinero, hacer mejor en el negocio, o alcanzar cualquier otro objetivo personal o profesional
Hacer cambios en solitario, o con otro individuo como un amigo o pareja

title: Swim!
description:
A fascinating story about the power of networking, connection, and mentorship 

Written as an engaging parable, Swim! How a Shark, a Suckerfish, and a Parasite Teach You Leadership, Mentoring, and Next Level Success brings to life real-world challenges (and their solutions) and presents them in simple, yet powerful terms. The book explores the vital importance of networking, explores the steps that lead to successful networking, and explains why we need it. 

Swim! dives deep into the concepts of mentorship and the power of human connection. While too many business leaders spend their time obsessing about facts, figures, and the bottom line, it is more important for them to learn to manage relationships. Once attention shifts to relationships, businesses and careers can reach the next level of success. Written by a leading motivational speaker, this book offers ideas that can be applied to both personal and business life.

Understand the importance of establishing habits and rituals
Tap into the power of a positive mindset
Discover the value of teamwork
Learn to use intentional language about workplace culture

Swim! is an entertaining book that highlights the significant concept of connecting and building relationships and includes the tools needed to become more self-aware about our roles and contributions in our industries.

Una vez que la atención cambia a las relaciones, las empresas y las carreras pueden alcanzar el próximo nivel de éxito. Escrito por un orador motivador líder, este libro ofrece ideas que se pueden aplicar tanto a la vida personal como a la empresa.

Comprender la importancia de establecer hábitos y rituales
Pulsa en el poder de una mentalidad positiva
Descubre el valor del trabajo en equipo
Aprender a utilizar lenguaje intencional sobre la cultura laboral

¡Swim! es un libro entretenido que destaca el concepto significativo de conexión y construcción de relaciones e incluye las herramientas necesarias para volverse más consciente de nuestros roles y contribuciones en nuestras industrias.

title: Ask More
description:
An Emmy-award-winning journalist reveals how to ask the QUESTIONS that make a difference.

What hidden skill links successful people in all walks of life? What helps them make smart decisions? The answer is surprisingly simple: They know how to ask the right questions at the right time.

Questions help us break down barriers, discover secrets, solve puzzles, and imagine new ways of doing things. But few of us know how to question in a methodical way. Emmy-award-winning journalist and media expert Frank Sesno aims to change that with Ask More.

From questions that cement relationships, to those that help us plan for the future, each chapter in Ask More explores a different type of inquiry. By the end of the book, you’ll know what to ask and when, what you should listen for, and what you can expect as the outcome. Packed with illuminating interviews, the book explains:

How the Gates Foundation used strategic questions to plan its battle against malaria
How turnaround expert Steve Miller uses diagnostic questions to get to the heart of a company’s problems
How NPR’s Terry Gross uses empathy questions to dig deeper
How journalist Anderson Cooper uses confrontational questions to hold people accountable
How creative questions animated a couple of techie dreamers to brainstorm Uber

Both intriguing and inspiring, Ask More shows how questions convey interest, feed curiosity, and reveal answers that can change the course of both your professional and personal life.
translatedDescription:
Un periodista ganador de Emmy revela cómo preguntar a las preguntas que marcan la diferencia.

¿Qué habilidad oculta vincula a personas exitosas en todos los paseos de la vida? ¿Qué les ayuda a tomar decisiones inteligentes? La respuesta es sorprendentemente simple: Saben hacer las preguntas correctas en el momento adecuado.

Las preguntas nos ayudan a romper barreras, descubrir secretos, resolver puzzles e imaginar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas. Pero pocos de nosotros sabemos cuestionar de manera metódica. Frank Sesno quiere cambiar eso con Ask More.

De preguntas que cementan relaciones, a aquellas que nos ayudan a planificar el futuro, cada capítulo en Ask More explora un tipo diferente de investigación. Al final del libro, sabrás qué preguntar y cuándo, qué debes escuchar y qué puedes esperar como resultado. Envasado con entrevistas iluminadoras, el libro explica:

Cómo la Fundación Gates utilizó cuestiones estratégicas para planificar su lucha contra el paludismo
Cómo el experto Steve Miller utiliza preguntas de diagnóstico para llegar al corazón de los problemas de una empresa
Cómo Terry Gross utiliza preguntas de empatía para profundizar
Cómo el periodista Anderson Cooper utiliza preguntas de confrontación para exigir responsabilidades a las personas
Cómo preguntas creativas animaron a un par de soñadores tecnológicos a la tormenta de cerebro Uber

Tanto intrigante como inspirador, Hacer Más muestra cómo las preguntas transmiten interés, alimentan la curiosidad y revelan respuestas que pueden cambiar el curso de tu vida profesional y personal.

title: Comprehensive Ruby Programming
description:
Dive into the world of Ruby programming with this detailed and practical guide. Covering everything from the basics of Ruby syntax to advanced topics such as metaprogramming and web frameworks, 'Comprehensive Ruby Programming' ensures you'll have all the tools needed to become a proficient Ruby developer.

What this Book will help me do

Become proficient in Ruby programming, from syntax to metaprogramming.
Develop and apply object-oriented programming techniques.
Master built-in Ruby methods and libraries to streamline coding.
Build and deploy practical Ruby applications, including 10 real-world projects.
Gain confidence working with Ruby web frameworks like Ruby on Rails and Sinatra.

Author(s)

Jordan Hudgens is a seasoned Ruby programmer and the lead instructor at a technology training institute. With a deep-rooted passion for teaching, he has years of experience crafting tutorials and books that make programming accessible to all. His hands-on approach ensures readers truly master concepts as they progress.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for absolute beginners and those new to programming who wish to learn Ruby from scratch. It's also a great fit for experienced developers looking to broaden their programming repertoire with a new language. If your goal is to build complete Ruby applications and understand the language thoroughly, this is the guide for you.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Hazte competente en la programación de Ruby, desde la sintaxis hasta la metaprogramación.
Desarrollar y aplicar técnicas de programación orientadas a objetos.
Master incorporado Ruby métodos y bibliotecas para simplificar la codificación.
Construir e implementar aplicaciones prácticas de Ruby, incluyendo 10 proyectos del mundo real.
Obtenga confianza trabajando con marcos web de Ruby como Ruby en Rails y Sinatra.

Autor(s)

Jordan Hudgens es un programador de Ruby experimentado y el instructor principal de un instituto de formación tecnológica. Este libro es ideal para principiantes absolutos y aquellos nuevos a la programación que desean aprender Ruby desde cero. También es un gran ajuste para desarrolladores experimentados que buscan ampliar su repertorio de programación con un nuevo lenguaje. Si su objetivo es construir aplicaciones completas de Ruby y entender el idioma a fondo, esta es la guía para usted.

title: HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself 2-Volume Collection
description:
If you read nothing else on managing yourself, read these definitive articles from Harvard Business Review.

You have the power to position yourself for success, cut your own career path, develop your skills, and shape the life you'll live. HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself 2-Volume Collection provides enduring ideas and practical advice to help you stay engaged, be productive, and continue to grow throughout your working life. Bringing together HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself and HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself, Vol. 2, this collection includes twenty articles selected by HBR's editors and features the indispensable article "How Will You Measure Your Life?" by Clayton M. Christensen.

From timeless classics to the latest game-changing ideas from thought leaders Peter F. Drucker, Daisy Dowling, Daniel Goleman, and Jennifer Petriglieri, and more, HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself 2-Volume Collection will inspire you to:

Identify areas for personal growth
Consider your strengths, work preferences, values, and contributions
Build your skills and stay relevant
Develop learning agility
Balance work, home, community, and self
Replenish your physical and mental energy
Rebound from tough times
Prepare for your next opportunity
Stay engaged throughout your 50+-year work life

HBR's 10 Must Reads paperback series is the definitive collection of books for new and experienced leaders alike. Leaders looking for the inspiration that big ideas provide, both to accelerate their own growth and that of their companies, should look no further. HBR's 10 Must Reads series focuses on the core topics that every ambitious manager needs to know: leadership, strategy, change, managing people, and managing yourself. Harvard Business Review has sorted through hundreds of articles and selected only the most essential reading on each topic. Each title includes timeless advice that will be relevant regardless of an ever‐changing business environment.

HBR's 10 Must Reads on Managing Yourself 2-Volume Collection proporciona ideas duraderas y consejos prácticos para ayudarle a mantenerse comprometido, ser productivo y seguir creciendo a lo largo de su vida laboral. Christensen.

De los clásicos atemporales a las últimas ideas de cambio de juego de los líderes del pensamiento Peter F. Drucker, Daisy Dowling, Daniel Goleman, y Jennifer Petriglieri, y más, HBR 10 Debe leer sobre administrarse 2-Volume Collection le inspirará a:

Identificar áreas para el crecimiento personal
Considere sus fortalezas, preferencias de trabajo, valores y contribuciones
Construir tus habilidades y mantenerte relevante
Desarrollar la agilidad del aprendizaje
Trabajo de equilibrio, hogar, comunidad y yo
Reponer su energía física y mental
Rebote de tiempos difíciles
Prepárate para tu próxima oportunidad
Mantente comprometido durante tu vida laboral de 50 años

La serie 10 Must Reads de HBR es la colección definitiva de libros para líderes nuevos y experimentados por igual. Los líderes que buscan la inspiración que las grandes ideas proporcionan, tanto para acelerar su propio crecimiento como el de sus empresas, no deben buscar más. La serie 10 Must Reads de HBR se centra en los temas básicos que cada ambiciosa gerente necesita saber: liderazgo, estrategia, cambio, gestión de la gente y gestión de ti mismo. Harvard Business Review ha organizado cientos de artículos y ha seleccionado sólo la lectura más esencial de cada tema. Cada título incluye consejos atemporales que serán relevantes independientemente de un entorno empresarial siempre cambiante.

title: Gray Hat Python
description:
Python is fast becoming the programming language of choice for hackers, reverse engineers, and software testers because it's easy to write quickly, and it has the low-level support and libraries that make hackers happy. But until now, there has been no real manual on how to use Python for a variety of hacking tasks. You had to dig through forum posts and man pages, endlessly tweaking your own code to get everything working. Not anymore.

Gray Hat Python explains the concepts behind hacking tools and techniques like debuggers, trojans, fuzzers, and emulators. But author Justin Seitz goes beyond theory, showing you how to harness existing Python-based security tools - and how to build your own when the pre-built ones won't cut it.

You'll learn how to:

Automate tedious reversing and security tasks
Design and program your own debugger
Learn how to fuzz Windows drivers and create powerful fuzzers from scratch
Have fun with code and library injection, soft and hard hooking techniques, and other software trickery
Sniff secure traffic out of an encrypted web browser session
Use PyDBG, Immunity Debugger, Sulley, IDAPython, PyEMU, and more

The world's best hackers are using Python to do their handiwork. Shouldn't you?
translatedDescription:
Python se está convirtiendo rápidamente en el lenguaje de programación de elección para hackers, ingenieros inversos y probadores de software porque es fácil de escribir rápidamente, y tiene el soporte de bajo nivel y bibliotecas que hacen felices a los hackers. Pero hasta ahora, no ha habido ningún manual real sobre cómo utilizar Python para una variedad de tareas de piratería. Tenías que cavar a través de mensajes de foro y páginas de hombre, sin fin retocando tu propio código para conseguir que todo funcione. Ya no.

Gray Hat Python explica los conceptos detrás de herramientas y técnicas de piratería como depuradores, troyanos, fuzzers y emuladores. Pero el autor Justin Seitz va más allá de la teoría, mostrándole cómo aprovechar las herramientas de seguridad existentes basadas en Python - y cómo construir su propio cuando los preconstruidos no lo cortarán.

Aprenderás a:

Automatizar tareas tediosas de inversión y seguridad
Diseño y programa tu propio depurador
Aprender a fusionar los controladores Windows y crear potentes fuzzers desde cero
Diviértete con la inyección de código y biblioteca, técnicas de conexión suaves y duras, y otros trucos de software
Sniff seguro tráfico fuera de una sesión de navegador web encriptada
Use PyDBG, Immunity Debugger, Sulley, IDAPython, PyEMU y más

Los mejores hackers del mundo están usando a Python para hacer su trabajo. ¿No deberías?

title: Still Standing
description:
Unlock the secrets of business resilience in this indispensable survival guide

In a world of disruption and uncertainty, Still Standing: What It Takes to Thrive and Innovate in a Messy World by Cherry Rose Tan emerges as a beacon of resilience, offering the essential strategies for navigating the pressures of building and leading our organizations into the future. Drawing on her vast experience as a veteran entrepreneur, speaker, and advisor, #REALTALK founder Cherry Rose Tan provides a roadmap for cultivating the mindset, heartset, and skillset necessary for enduring success. Her impact on the mental health movement within the tech industry has been nothing short of revolutionary, helping leaders come to grips with the real stress and pressures associated with their daily work.

In the book, you'll learn how to:

Cultivate a resilient workplace culture that embraces change and innovation, battle tested with 40,000 leaders across 27 verticals
Master tough conversations, learning how to effectively communicate with yourself, your team, and key stakeholders to execute in difficult environments
Empower yourself and your team with actionable strategies, combining leadership wisdom and practical tools drawn from the crucible of real-world entrepreneurship

Still Standing is not just a book; it's a tactical roadmap for businesses and their leaders, who are determined to create everyday resilience in the face of constant change. Whether you're seeking to enhance your leadership skills, navigate the challenges of business, or manage workplace burnout and wellbeing, this book offers the insights and strategies needed to thrive and innovate in these uncertain times. Join Cherry Rose Tan in exploring the three capabilities that will empower you to not just survive, but flourish in the competitive world of business and innovation.
translatedDescription:
Desbloquear los secretos de la resiliencia empresarial en esta guía de supervivencia indispensable

En un mundo de perturbación e incertidumbre, todavía permanente: lo que se necesita para impulsar e innovar en un mundo de Messy por Cherry Rose Tan emerge como un faro de resiliencia, ofreciendo las estrategias esenciales para navegar las presiones de construir y llevar a nuestras organizaciones al futuro. Basándose en su vasta experiencia como empresario veterano, orador y asesor, el fundador de #REALTALK Cherry Rose Tan proporciona una hoja de ruta para cultivar la mentalidad, el corazón y las habilidades necesarias para el éxito duradero. Su impacto en el movimiento de salud mental dentro de la industria tecnológica no ha sido nada menos que revolucionario, ayudando a los líderes a lidiar con el estrés real y las presiones asociadas con su trabajo diario.

En el libro aprenderás a:

Cultivar una cultura de trabajo resistente que abraza el cambio y la innovación, batalla probada con 40.000 líderes en 27 verticales
Master conversaciones duras, aprender a comunicarse eficazmente con usted mismo, su equipo y los principales interesados para ejecutar en entornos difíciles
Empoderarse a sí mismo y a su equipo con estrategias de acción, combinando sabiduría de liderazgo y herramientas prácticas extraídas del crisol de emprendimiento del mundo real

Todavía Standing no es sólo un libro; es una hoja de ruta táctica para las empresas y sus líderes, que están decididos a crear resiliencia cotidiana ante el cambio constante. Ya sea que usted está tratando de mejorar sus habilidades de liderazgo, navegar por los desafíos del negocio, o gestionar el agotamiento y el bienestar del lugar de trabajo, este libro ofrece las ideas y estrategias necesarias para prosperar e innovar en estos tiempos inciertos. Únase a Cherry Rose Tan en explorar las tres capacidades que le permitirán no sólo sobrevivir, sino florecer en el mundo competitivo de negocios e innovación.

title: Ruby on Rails™ Tutorial: Learn Web Development with Rails, Fourth Edition
description:
“Ruby on Rails™ Tutorial by Michael Hartl has become a must-read for developers learning how to build Rails apps.” — Peter Cooper, Editor of Ruby Inside

Used by sites as varied as Twitter, GitHub, Disney, and Airbnb, Ruby on Rails is one of the most popular frameworks for developing web applications, but it can be challenging to learn and use. Whether you’re new to web development or new only to Rails, Ruby on Rails™ Tutorial, Fourth Edition, is the solution.

Best-selling author and leading Rails developer Michael Hartl teaches Rails by guiding you through the development of three example applications of increasing sophistication. The tutorial’s examples focus on the general principles of web development needed for virtually any kind of website. The updates to this edition include full compatibility with Rails 5, a division of the largest chapters into more manageable units, and a huge number of new exercises interspersed in each chapter for maximum reinforcement of the material.

This indispensable guide provides integrated tutorials not only for Rails, but also for the essential Ruby, HTML, CSS, and SQL skills you need when developing web applications. Hartl explains how each new technique solves a real-world problem, and then he demonstrates it with bite-sized code that’s simple enough to understand, yet novel enough to be useful. Whatever your previous web development experience, this book will guide you to true Rails mastery.

This book will help you

Install and set up your Rails development environment, including pre-installed integrated development environment (IDE) in the cloud

Go beyond generated code to truly understand how to build Rails applications from scratch

Learn testing and test-driven development (TDD)

Effectively use the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern

Structure applications using the REST architecture

Build static pages and transform them into dynamic ones

Master the Ruby programming skills all Rails developers need

Create high-quality site layouts and data models

Implement registration and authentication systems, including validation and secure passwords

Update, display, and delete users

Upload images in production using a cloud storage service

Implement account activation and password reset, including sending email with Rails

Add social features and microblogging, including an introduction to Ajax

Record version changes with Git and create a secure remote repository at Bitbucket

Deploy your applications early and often with Heroku
translatedDescription:
“Ruby on RailsTM Tutorial de Michael Hartl se ha convertido en un deber de leer para los desarrolladores aprendiendo a construir aplicaciones Rails”. — Peter Cooper, editor de Ruby Inside

Utilizado por sitios tan variados como Twitter, GitHub, Disney y Airbnb, Ruby on Rails es uno de los marcos más populares para desarrollar aplicaciones web, pero puede ser difícil aprender y utilizar. Ya sea nuevo en el desarrollo web o nuevo sólo en Rails, Ruby en RailsTM Tutorial, Cuarta Edición, es la solución.

El autor más vendido y desarrollador de Rails Michael Hartl enseña Rails guiándole a través del desarrollo de tres aplicaciones de ejemplo de creciente sofisticación. Los ejemplos del tutorial se centran en los principios generales del desarrollo web necesarios para prácticamente cualquier tipo de sitio web. Las actualizaciones de esta edición incluyen compatibilidad total con Rails 5, una división de los capítulos más grandes en unidades más manejables, y un gran número de nuevos ejercicios intercalados en cada capítulo para el máximo refuerzo del material.

Esta guía indispensable proporciona tutoriales integrados no sólo para Rails, sino también para las habilidades esenciales de Ruby, HTML, CSS y SQL que necesitas al desarrollar aplicaciones web. Hartl explica cómo cada nueva técnica resuelve un problema del mundo real, y luego lo demuestra con un código tamaño de mordedura que es lo suficientemente simple para entender, pero lo suficientemente nuevo para ser útil. Sea cual sea su experiencia de desarrollo web anterior, este libro le guiará a la verdadera maestría de Rails.

Este libro te ayudará.

Instalar y configurar el entorno de desarrollo Rails, incluyendo el entorno de desarrollo integrado preinstalado (IDE) en la nube

Ir más allá del código generado para entender realmente cómo construir aplicaciones Rails desde cero

Aprender pruebas y desarrollo impulsado por pruebas (TDD)

Utilizar eficazmente el patrón de Controlador de Vista Modelo (MVC)

Aplicaciones de estructura usando la arquitectura REST

Construir páginas estáticas y transformarlas en dinámicas

Máster en las habilidades de programación Ruby todos los desarrolladores Rails necesitan

Crear diseños de sitios de alta calidad y modelos de datos

Implementar sistemas de registro y autenticación, incluyendo validación y contraseñas seguras

Actualizar, mostrar y eliminar usuarios

Subir imágenes en producción utilizando un servicio de almacenamiento en la nube

Implementar la activación de la cuenta y restablecer la contraseña, incluyendo el envío de correo electrónico con Rails

Añadir características sociales y microblogging, incluyendo una introducción a Ajax

Cambiar la versión con Git y crear un repositorio remoto seguro en Bitbucket

Despliegue sus aplicaciones temprano y a menudo con Heroku

title: The Little Book of Results
description:
'It is easier to complicate than to simplify' - this book takes up that challenge and aims to refine and clarify the theories in the original Results to produce a more succinct route to clarity and better results for the reader - because we all want to see results at home, at work and in life!

Using transformational coaching techniques, examples, exercises and metaphors, Jamie talks the reader through the three key changes they need to achieve the results they are after and inspire others to do the same. Based on the principles of The Clarity Coaching Model, the reader will learn how to de-congest their mind to think more clearly, make better decisions and improve performance – achieving the ‘flow’ state attributed to the results of top-flight individuals. Clearer thinking removes the stress and anxiety from decision making and allows you to focus on your goals. Rather than a step-by-step process, the reader is encouraged to form a deep understanding of themselves to awaken their inner potential and improve their innate abilities including better listening, deeper connections, more motivation and greater innovation and creativity.
translatedDescription:
'Es más fácil complicar que simplificar' - este libro toma ese desafío y pretende refinar y aclarar las teorías en los resultados originales para producir una ruta más sucinta a la claridad y mejores resultados para el lector - porque todos queremos ver resultados en casa, en el trabajo y en la vida!

Utilizando técnicas de coaching transformacional, ejemplos, ejercicios y metáforas, Jamie habla al lector a través de los tres cambios clave que necesitan para lograr los resultados que buscan e inspirar a otros a hacer lo mismo. Basado en los principios del Modelo de Entrenamiento de la Claridad, el lector aprenderá a descongestionar su mente para pensar más claramente, tomar mejores decisiones y mejorar el rendimiento – lograr el estado de "flujo" atribuido a los resultados de los individuos de alto vuelo. El pensamiento más claro elimina el estrés y la ansiedad de la toma de decisiones y le permite centrarse en sus objetivos. En lugar de un proceso paso a paso, se alienta al lector a formar una comprensión profunda de sí mismos para despertar su potencial interior y mejorar sus habilidades innatas incluyendo una mejor escucha, conexiones más profundas, más motivación y mayor innovación y creatividad.

title: Brave Together: Lead by Design, Spark Creativity, and Shape the Future with the Power of Co-Creation
description:
Brave Together is a powerful book that can transform the lives of leaders, creators, or anyone looking to shape the future. It comes from the thought leaders who helped Apple shift the culture from “thinking different” to “working different together.”

“Groundbreaking. Get ready to be inspired and join the co-creation movement.”—Marshall Goldsmith, Thinkers50 #1 Executive Coach and New York Times bestselling author of The Earned Life

“Brave Together is an exhilarating exploration of genuine collaboration, where every voice matters and every idea is a potential catalyst for transformation.”—Daniel H. Pink, #1 New York Times bestselling author of Drive, To Sell is Human, and The Power of Regret

How did Apple overcome a culture of secrecy? How did Pixar out-innovate Disney? Why do companies kill creativity? Does Shark Tank teach us something about the way we pursue success that isn’t true?

We’ve been told that working harder and smarter is the only way to succeed in business and life. But it’s not true. Hustle culture is causing burnout and pain in our lives, making us feel divided. What if instead we focused on working creatively with others? And asked How can we shape cultures people love? There is hope in co-creation.

Brave Together is a deep exploration into how we can live and lead as co-creators, filled with unexpected stories, powerful principles, and a future-oriented framework. The authors have pressure-tested this work with startups and Fortune 500s—including Apple. Coaching leaders how to reimagine their approach to culture, converting creative ideas into billion-dollar solutions with the help of these patterns:

The Mirror Test: Take ownership of your reality and your creative identity.

The Hero’s Sacrifice: Break free of ego to connect with others in inspiring ways.

Become the Future: Create a synthesis, manifesting the best in mind, heart, and spirit.

Chris Deaver and Ian Clawson have written a handbook that challenges the status quo approach to leadership, work, and culture. It offers the path to a bright future that isn’t self-made but shared.
translatedDescription:
Brave Together es un libro poderoso que puede transformar las vidas de los líderes, creadores, o cualquier persona que busque dar forma al futuro. Viene de los líderes del pensamiento que ayudaron a Apple a cambiar la cultura de “pensar diferente” a “trabajar juntos”.

Rompedor. Prepárate para ser inspirado y unirse al movimiento de co-creación.”—Marshall Goldsmith, Thinkers50 #1 Executive Coach y New York Times autor bestselling de The Earned Life

“Brave Together es una exploración estimulante de una colaboración genuina, donde cada voz importa y cada idea es un potencial catalizador para la transformación”. Daniel H. Pink, #1 New York Times autor bestselling de Drive, vender es humano, y el poder del arrepentimiento

¿Cómo superó Apple una cultura del secreto? ¿Cómo ha ido Pixar a innovar a Disney? ¿Por qué las empresas matan la creatividad? ¿Shark Tank nos enseña algo sobre la forma en que buscamos el éxito que no es verdad?

Nos han dicho que trabajar más duro y más inteligente es la única manera de tener éxito en los negocios y la vida. Pero no es verdad. La cultura silenciosa está causando quemaduras y dolor en nuestras vidas, haciéndonos sentir divididos. ¿Y si en cambio nos centramos en trabajar creativamente con otros? Y preguntó ¿Cómo podemos formar culturas que la gente ama? Hay esperanza en la co-creación.

Brave Together es una exploración profunda de cómo podemos vivir y liderar como co-creadores, llenos de historias inesperadas, principios poderosos y un marco orientado hacia el futuro. Los autores han probado este trabajo con startups y Fortune 500s, incluyendo Apple. Coaching líderes cómo reimaginar su enfoque a la cultura, convirtiendo ideas creativas en soluciones multimillonarias con la ayuda de estos patrones:

The Mirror Test: Tome la propiedad de su realidad y su identidad creativa.

Sacrificio del héroe: Rompe libre de ego para conectarse con otros de maneras inspiradoras.

Convertirse en el futuro: Crear una síntesis, manifestando lo mejor en mente, corazón y espíritu.

Chris Deaver e Ian Clawson han escrito un manual que desafía el enfoque status quo para el liderazgo, el trabajo y la cultura. Ofrece el camino a un futuro brillante que no es hecho por sí mismo sino compartido.

title: The Anxious Achiever
description:
Named one of the ten "Best New Management books of the year" by Thinkers50. Winner, Axiom Award for 2023 "Best Leadership Book."

Turn anxiety into a leadership superpower—from entrepreneur, mental health advocate, and top-rated podcaster Morra Aarons-Mele.

Anxiety disorders are the most common mental illnesses in the world. But in our workplaces, anxiety has been a hidden problem—there in plain sight but ignored. Until now.

The Anxious Achiever is a book with a mission: to normalize anxiety and leadership. As leadership expert and self-proclaimed anxious achiever Morra Aarons-Mele argues, anxiety is built into the very nature of leadership. It can—and should—be harnessed into a force for good.

Inspired by the popular podcast of the same name, The Anxious Achiever is filled with personal stories, research-based insights into mental health, and lots of practical advice. You'll learn how to:

Figure out your own anxiety profile so that you can recognize and avoid common thought traps and triggers
Confront bad habits and unhealthy coping mechanisms
Resist perfectionism, manage social anxiety, and set boundaries to prevent burnout
Deal with feedback, criticism, and impostor syndrome
Learn to love—and lead with—your complex brain
Model—and communicate—healthy behavior as a leader

Whether you're experiencing anxiety for the first time or have been battling it for years, The Anxious Achiever will help you turn your stress and worries into a source of strength for yourself, your career, and the people you lead.
translatedDescription:
Nombrado uno de los diez "Mejores libros de Gestión del año" por Thinkers50. Ganador, Premio Axiom para 2023 "Mejor Libro de Liderazgo".

Convierta la ansiedad en una superpotencia de liderazgo —de empresarios, defensores de la salud mental, y el podcaster Morra Aarons-Mele.

Los trastornos de ansiedad son las enfermedades mentales más comunes del mundo. Pero en nuestros lugares de trabajo, la ansiedad ha sido un problema oculto, hay a simple vista pero ignorado. Hasta ahora.

El Achiever Ansioso es un libro con una misión: normalizar la ansiedad y el liderazgo. Como argumenta el experto en liderazgo y autoproclamado logro ansioso Morra Aarons-Mele, la ansiedad se construye en la misma naturaleza del liderazgo. Puede, y debe, ser aprovechado en una fuerza para el bien.

Inspirado en el podcast popular del mismo nombre, The Anxious Achiever está lleno de historias personales, ideas basadas en la investigación sobre la salud mental, y muchos consejos prácticos. Aprenderás a:

Averigüe su propio perfil de ansiedad para que pueda reconocer y evitar trampas y disparadores comunes de pensamiento
Confrontar malos hábitos y mecanismos de afrontamiento poco saludables
Resistir el perfeccionismo, manejar la ansiedad social y establecer límites para prevenir el agotamiento
Tratar con retroalimentación, crítica y síndrome de impostor
Aprende a amar y liderar con tu cerebro complejo
Modelo y comunicación: comportamiento saludable como líder

Ya sea que estés experimentando ansiedad por primera vez o has estado luchando durante años, The Anxious Achiever te ayudará a convertir tu estrés y tus preocupaciones en una fuente de fuerza para ti, tu carrera y la gente que lideras.

title: Advanced CORBA® Programming with C++
description:
Here is the CORBA book that every C++ software engineer has been waiting for. Advanced CORBA® Programming with C++ provides designers and developers with the tools required to understand CORBA technology at the architectural, design, and source code levels. This book offers hands-on explanations for building efficient applications, as well as lucid examples that provide practical advice on avoiding costly mistakes. With this book as a guide, programmers will find the support they need to successfully undertake industrial-strength CORBA development projects.

The content is systematically arranged and presented so the book may be used as both a tutorial and a reference. The rich example programs in this definitive text show CORBA developers how to write clearer code that is more maintainable, portable, and efficient. The authors' detailed coverage of the IDL-to-C++ mapping moves beyond the mechanics of the APIs to discuss topics such as potential pitfalls and efficiency. An in-depth presentation of the new Portable Object Adapter (POA) explains how to take advantage of its numerous features to create scalable and high-performance servers. In addition, detailed discussion of advanced topics, such as garbage collection and multithreading, provides developers with the knowledge they need to write commercial applications.

In-depth coverage of IDL, including common idioms and design trade-offs

Complete and detailed explanations of the Life Cycle, Naming, Trading, and Event Services

Discussion of IIOP and implementation repositories

Insight into the dynamic aspects of CORBA, such as dynamic typing and the new DynAny interfaces

Advice on selecting appropriate application architectures and designs

Detailed, portable, and vendor-independent source code

title: Perl Template Toolkit
description:
Among the many different approaches to "templating" with Perl--such as Embperl, Mason, HTML::Template, and hundreds of other lesser known systems--the Template Toolkit is widely recognized as one of the most versatile. Like other templating systems, the Template Toolkit allows programmers to embed Perl code and custom macros into HTML documents in order to create customized documents on the fly. But unlike the others, the Template Toolkit is as facile at producing HTML as it is at producing XML, PDF, or any other output format. And because it has its own simple templating language, templates can be written and edited by people who don't know Perl. In short, the Template Toolkit combines the best features of its competitors, with ease-of-use and flexibility, resulting in a technology that's fast, powerful and extensible, and ideally suited to the production and maintenance of web content and other dynamic document systems.In Perl Template Toolkit you'll find detailed coverage of this increasingly popular technology. Written by core members of the technology's development team, the book guides you through the entire process of installing, configuring, using, and extending the Template Toolkit. It begins with a fast-paced but thorough tutorial on building web content with the Template Toolkit, and then walks you through generating and using data files, particularly with XML. It also provides detailed information on the Template Toolkit's modules, libraries, and tools in addition to a complete reference manual.Topics in the book include:

Getting started with the template toolkit
The Template language
Template directives
Filters
Plugins
Extending the Template Toolkit
Accessing databases
XML
Advanced static web page techniques
Dynamic web content and web applications
The only book to cover this important tool, Perl Template Toolkit is essential reading for any Perl programmer who wants to create dynamic web content that is remarkably easy to maintain. This book is your surefire guide to implementing this fast, flexible, and powerful templating system.

title: Crushing the IT Gender Bias: Thriving as a Woman in Technology
description:
Conscious and unconscious bias, societal pressures, and discomfort with women’s ambition are issues that women are confronted with in any male-dominated setting, and tech is no exception. Statistically, women are a disproportionately small percentage of the technology industry. How did we get here, what is changing, and what can future generations of women in STEM expect?
In Crushing the IT Gender Bias, author Kellyn Pot’Vin-Gorman applies her two decades of experience in tech to these meaningful questions, plus many more. As a mentor and sponsor of women in the database and development communities, Pot’Vin-Gorman uses experience, visualizations of hard data, and industry interviews to describe the many challenges that women face in STEM. She then shows you how to inoculate against them. Small, positive changes like these are similar to a vaccine: they build individual immunity and thus create herd immunity to protect the most vulnerable. This shift is accomplished through increased representation of—and direct exposure to—successful role models in the industry.
You’ll get practical advice related to hiring practices, salary negotiations, and barriers to collaboration. After witnessing multiple female peers depart the tech world, Pot’Vin-Gorman has written Crushing the IT Gender Bias to make her voice heard and to start this necessary conversation productively so that women can thrive. Additionally, this book is for male professionals who desire to grow in their understanding and eliminate bias in their environments.
Do not be content with mere survival. Read this book, practice the techniques, and, most importantly, learn how to pay it forward. By arming yourself with knowledge and facing bias head-on, you can be the meaningful change that you want to see in the tech industry.
Who This Book Is For
Women in any area of technology with a desire to make and lead positive change by eliminating conscious and unconscious bias along with strategically confronting the many issues facing women in a field dominated by cultural bias. The book appeals to those just starting a career through to seasoned professionals, and even to those entering the management tier. This book also welcomes men with a desire to grow in their understanding and eliminate bias in the world around them.
translatedDescription:

Estadísticamente, las mujeres son un porcentaje desproporcionadamente pequeño de la industria tecnológica. ¿Cómo llegamos aquí, qué está cambiando, y qué pueden esperar las generaciones futuras de mujeres en STEM?
En Crushing the IT Gender Bias, la autora Kellyn Pot’Vin-Gorman aplica sus dos décadas de experiencia en tecnología a estas preguntas significativas, además de muchas más. Como mentora y patrocinadora de mujeres en las comunidades de base de datos y desarrollo, Pot’Vin-Gorman utiliza experiencia, visualizaciones de datos duros y entrevistas de la industria para describir los numerosos desafíos que enfrentan las mujeres en STEM. Ella te muestra cómo inocular contra ellos. Pequeños cambios positivos como estos son similares a una vacuna: construyen inmunidad individual y crean así inmunidad de manada para proteger a los más vulnerables. Este cambio se logra mediante una mayor representación de modelos exitosos en la industria y la exposición directa a ellos.
Tendrás consejos prácticos relacionados con prácticas de contratación, negociaciones salariales y barreras a la colaboración. Después de presenciar a múltiples pares de mujeres que salen del mundo tecnológico, Pot’Vin-Gorman ha escrito Crushing the IT Gender Bias para hacer oír su voz y comenzar esta conversación necesaria de manera productiva para que las mujeres puedan prosperar. Además, este libro es para los profesionales masculinos que desean crecer en su comprensión y eliminar sesgo en sus entornos.
No te contentes con la mera supervivencia. Lea este libro, practique las técnicas y, lo más importante, aprenda a pagarlo. Al armarse con el conocimiento y enfrentarse al sesgo, puede ser el cambio significativo que desea ver en la industria tecnológica.
Quién es este libro
Las mujeres en cualquier área de tecnología con el deseo de hacer y dirigir un cambio positivo eliminando el sesgo consciente e inconsciente junto con confrontar estratégicamente las muchas cuestiones que enfrentan las mujeres en un campo dominado por el sesgo cultural. title: Power Relationships: 26 Irrefutable Laws for Building Extraordinary Relationships
description:
The Relationship Laws that Drive Success

There are powerful but invisible laws that determine whether your relationships —with your clients, colleagues, and friends—will thrive or wither. These relationship laws are ever-present. When you align with them, the results are dramatic. Your network will grow rapidly. You'll be seen by clients as a trusted partner rather than an expense to be managed. And you'll find the people around you eager to help you succeed.

When you ignore the laws, however, your efforts will falter. Relationship building will seem like very hard work.

Power Relationships gives readers a unique, entertaining guide to relationship success at work and in life. Each of the 26 laws is illustrated and explained using a compelling, real-life story that shows how to implement it. The second section of the book presents 16 common relationship challenges with specific solutions. You'll read about:

The top Citigroup executive whose relationship with a CEO was changed forever on a business trip that exploded into chaos, and how you can use the same principle to deepen your own relationships.

The philanthropist who, on the verge of being mugged in a dark parking lot, learns how his actions have had an unimaginable ripple effect across several generations

How one of the authors flew halfway around the world and used Law 18—"Make them curious"—to turn a make-or-break, five-minute meeting with a top executive into a long-term relationship.

The chance encounter on an airplane with a famous actor that revealed a simple but profound truth. It's Law 25: "Build your network before you need it."

Sobel (author of Clients for Life, All for One, and Power Questions (with Panas)) and Panas (author of Asking and Supremely Successful Selling) have sold over half a million books and are the leading authorities in their field. Power Relationships is a unique, road-tested guide to relationship success.

title: JRuby Cookbook
description:
If you're interested in JRuby, you probably don't need a tutorial on Ruby, Rails, or Java -- you just need to know how to get things done. This Cookbook offers practical solutions for using the Java implementation of the Ruby language, with targeted recipes for deploying Rails web applications on Java servers, integrating JRuby code with Java technologies, developing JRuby desktop applications with Java toolkits, and more. Using numerous reusable code samples, JRuby Cookbook shows you how to:

Install and update JRuby on Windows, Mac OS X, and Linux, and IDEs such as NetBeans and Eclipse
Package and deploy Rails apps on Java Servlet containers and Java EE application servers, including JBoss, Tomcat, and GlassFish
Integrate Ruby and Rails applications with popular Java EE technologies such as JMS, JMX, JPA, Spring, and Hibernate
Develop desktop and client applications with cross-platform Java UI technologies and toolkits such as Swing, SWT, and Java 2D
Maximize the flexibility of your testing and build environment, using both existing Java-based tools such as Ant and Maven and newer Ruby-based tools such as Rake, Raven, and Buildr

The JRuby interpreter combines Ruby's simplicity and ease of use with Java's extensive libraries and technologies, a potent blend that opens new possibilities for Ruby, Rails, and Java. This Cookbook helps you take full advantage of JRuby's potential."The JRuby Cookbook is an excellent book for any polyglot who is trying to bridge the gap between Java and Ruby. It provides solutions to specific problems developers face in both their development and testing environments, along with the applications they're building."-- Bob McWhirter, Research & Prototyping, Red Hat Middleware

Paquete e implementa aplicaciones Rails en contenedores Servlet Java y servidores de aplicaciones Java EE, incluyendo JBoss, Tomcat y GlassFish
Integrar aplicaciones Ruby y Rails con tecnologías populares Java EE como JMS, JMX, JPA, Spring y Hibernate
Desarrollar aplicaciones de escritorio y clientes con tecnologías de interfaz de usuario de Java y conjuntos de herramientas como Swing, SWT y Java 2D

title: Beginning Ruby: From Novice to Professional, Third Edition
description:
Learn the principles behind object-oriented programming and within a few chapters create a fully functional Ruby application. You'll also gain a basic understanding of many ancillary technologies such as databases, XML, web frameworks, and networking - some of which are needed as part of a fully functioning Ruby application.

Based on the bestselling first and second editions, Beginning Ruby, Third Edition is a leading guide to learn Ruby from the ground up. The new edition of this book provides the same excellent introduction to Ruby as the previous editions plus updates for the newest version of Ruby 2.3. This book can also be used as a textbook or companion to a textbook on beginning Ruby programming.

The light and agile Ruby programming language remains a very popular open source scripting option for developers building today's web and even some enterprise applications. And, now, Ruby also has applications using the Raspberry Pi, popular among hobbyists and makers. Many former Java developers still use Ruby on Rails today, the most popular framework for building Ruby applications.

What You'll Learn

Discover the fundamentals of Ruby and its object-oriented building blocks
Use the Ruby libraries, gems, and documentation
Work with files and databases
Write and deploy Ruby applications
Harness the various Ruby web frameworks and how to use them
Do network programming with Ruby

Who This Book Is For

Beginning programmers, programmers new to Ruby, and web developers interested in learning and knowing the foundations of the Ruby programming language.

También obtendrá una comprensión básica de muchas tecnologías auxiliares como bases de datos, marcos XML, web y redes, algunas de las cuales son necesarias como parte de una aplicación Ruby totalmente funcional.

Basado en las mejores ediciones primera y segunda, Beginning Ruby, Third Edition es una guía líder para aprender Ruby desde el suelo. La nueva edición de este libro proporciona la misma excelente introducción a Ruby como las ediciones anteriores más actualizaciones para la versión más reciente de Ruby 2.3. Este libro también se puede utilizar como libro de texto o compañero de un libro de texto sobre el inicio de la programación de Ruby.

El lenguaje de programación de Ruby ligero y ágil sigue siendo una opción de scripting de código abierto muy popular para los desarrolladores que construyen la web de hoy e incluso algunas aplicaciones empresariales. Y, ahora, Ruby también tiene aplicaciones usando el Raspberry Pi, popular entre hobbyists y fabricantes. Muchos antiguos desarrolladores de Java todavía utilizan Ruby en Rails hoy, el marco más popular para la construcción de aplicaciones de Ruby.

Lo que aprenderás

Descubra los fundamentos de Ruby y sus bloques de construcción orientados a objetos
Utilice las bibliotecas, gemas y documentación de Ruby
Trabajar con archivos y bases de datos

Harness los diversos marcos web de Ruby y cómo utilizarlos
Do programación de red con Ruby

title: Do Big Things
description:
An inspiring, practical and progress-oriented blueprint for energetic achievement.

Amid constant swirl, uncertainty, and complexity is your team capable of doing big things? Too often people are pulled together, labeled a “team,” given a directive, and expected to deliver results quickly. Soon, however, due to lack of focus, increasing pressures and competing priorities the team suffers from DSD: distracted, hopelessly stressed and disconnected from one another. Predictably, the team flatlines and the energy needed to succeed is lost.

Based upon research of what successful teams do to overcome severe odds, Do Big Things presents an intuitive, seven-step process that equips teams with how to quickly and consistently operate in a manner necessary for success.

Team members develop the self-awareness and ability to:

Bring their best to every situation
Bring out the best in others in every interaction
Partner across the business to deliver common objectives

Filled with practical tools and engaging stories of teams today, Do Big Things equips leaders with “the how” to quickly identify and activate the behaviors needed to achieve more than you or your team ever thought possible. Idea and information exchanges interlock the hand, head and heart of each team member to get everyone moving toward a common goal. Increasingly, individually and collectively, the team becomes emotionally stronger and more productive as they do their work.

Do Big Things provides your team with the common language necessary to be authentic, empathetic and transparent, so that potential barriers to success come to light – faster. This empowers the team to be more accountable with an enterprise mindset, because they can have the profound discussions needed to adapt quicker to unforeseen challenges and demonstrate an innovative reflex.

By applying the concepts in this book, the team’s daily interactions are transformed, focus is sustained, and energetic progress toward your goals is triggered. Every member of your team wants to succeed. Do Big Things provides a straightforward method to bring greater meaning to the work everyone does so the team delivers extraordinary performance together.

You know what your team can achieve—now use the proven method to enable them to do it.
translatedDescription:
Un proyecto inspirador, práctico y orientado hacia el progreso para lograr logros energéticos.

¿En medio de un constante giro, incertidumbre y complejidad es su equipo capaz de hacer grandes cosas? Con demasiada frecuencia las personas se reúnen, etiquetan un equipo, dado una directiva, y se espera que proporcione resultados rápidamente. Pronto, sin embargo, debido a la falta de atención, las crecientes presiones y las prioridades competitivas que el equipo sufre de DSD: distraído, inesperadamente estresado y desconectado entre sí. Predeciblemente, se pierden las líneas planas del equipo y la energía necesaria para tener éxito.

Basado en la investigación de lo que los equipos exitosos hacen para superar las probabilidades graves, Do Big Things presenta un proceso intuitivo de siete pasos que equipa a los equipos con la forma de operar rápida y consistentemente de una manera necesaria para el éxito.

Los miembros del equipo desarrollan la conciencia y la capacidad de:

Traiga lo mejor posible a cada situación
Saca lo mejor de los demás en cada interacción
Socio en todo el negocio para ofrecer objetivos comunes

Lleno de herramientas prácticas e historias atractivas de equipos hoy, Do Big Things equipa a los líderes con “el cómo” para identificar y activar rápidamente los comportamientos necesarios para lograr más de lo que usted o su equipo jamás pensó posible. Los intercambios de ideas e información entrelazan la mano, la cabeza y el corazón de cada miembro del equipo para conseguir que todo el mundo se mueva hacia un objetivo común. Cada vez más, individual y colectivamente, el equipo se vuelve emocionalmente más fuerte y más productivo al hacer su trabajo.

Hacer grandes cosas proporciona a su equipo el lenguaje común necesario para ser auténtico, empático y transparente, de modo que las barreras potenciales para el éxito lleguen a la luz – más rápido. Esto faculta al equipo a ser más responsable con una mentalidad empresarial, ya que pueden tener los profundos debates necesarios para adaptar los desafíos más rápidos e imprevistos y demostrar un reflejo innovador.

Al aplicar los conceptos en este libro, las interacciones diarias del equipo se transforman, se centran y se activa el progreso energético hacia sus objetivos. Cada miembro de su equipo quiere tener éxito. Do Big Things proporciona un método sencillo para aportar un mayor significado al trabajo que todo el mundo hace así que el equipo ofrece un rendimiento extraordinario juntos.

Usted sabe lo que su equipo puede lograr, ahora utilice el método probado para permitir que lo hagan.

title: Applications Interface Programming Using Multiple Languages: A Windows® Programmer's Guide
description:
Interface techniques between multiple different languages taught by examples—the only book of its kind!
Ideal for anyone programming in more than one language
Hands-on work with a wide range of languages and applications

Your practical guide to interfacing multiple programming languages.

Please note: This title included additional digital media in print format. The supplemental content is not included for this digital book edition.

Computer applications and their implementations become more complex and specialized by the day. Often, the best way to meet a particular challenge is to apply two or more programming languages to the task. The scarcity of useful information on how to get different languages to work together, though, makes this much easier said than done! To that end, topic expert Dr. Ying Bai wrote Applications Interface Programming Using Multiple Languages: A Windows Programmer’s Guide—the first book to provide in-depth coverage of the most popular programming languages’ interfaces and how to use them.

This hands-on, example-packed book walks you through everything you need to know about interfacing multiple languages in Windows, including combinations of C/C++ and Visual C++ 6.0; Visual Basic 6.0; MATLAB, MATLAB Compiler, and the MATLAB graphics and C/C++ math libraries; Smalltalk; VisualWorks; LabVIEW, LabWindows/CVI, Measurement Studio for Visual C++ and Measurement Studio for Visual Basic; Java 1.2 and 1.3; Perl; and more. title: The Discomfort Zone
description: You want people to stretch their limits, but your conversations meant to help them often fall flat or backfire, creating more resistance than growth. Top leadership coach Marcia Reynolds offers a model for using the Discomfort Zone—the moment when the mind is most open to learning—to prompt people to think through problems, see situations more strategically, and transcend their limitations. Drawing on recent discoveries in the neuroscience of learning, Reynolds shows how to ask the kinds of questions that short-circuit the brain’s defense mechanisms and habitual thought patterns. Then, instead of being told, people see for themselves the insightful and often profound solutions to what is stopping their progress. The exercises and case studies will help you use discomfort in your conversations to create lasting changes and an enlivened workforce.

Basándose en descubrimientos recientes en la neurociencia del aprendizaje, Reynolds muestra cómo hacer los tipos de preguntas que cortocircuitan los mecanismos de defensa del cerebro y los patrones habituales de pensamiento. Entonces, en lugar de ser dicho, la gente ve por sí misma las soluciones perspicaces y a menudo profundas a lo que impide su progreso. Los ejercicios y estudios de casos le ayudarán a usar molestias en sus conversaciones para crear cambios duraderos y una fuerza de trabajo animada.

title: Extending Swift Value(s) to the Server
description:
Swift quickly became the dominant language for iOS app development not long after Apple introduced the language in 2014. When Swift moved to open source, extending this modern language from client to server side became an option, and today, with Swift 3.0, companies can extend the value of Swift end-to-end. With this ebook, you’ll learn how to write your entire application in Swift—from mobile client to the middle tier to server-side database access.

Authors David Ungar and Robert Dickerson take you through Swift’s support for object-oriented, functional, and imperative programming, and then show you how to build a Swifty web service that interfaces with other services and databases. By demonstrating how Swift is related to Java and Javascript, two leading technologies currently used on clients and servers today, this ebook extends your repertoire of skills with one of today's most in-demand languages.

Learn how Swift produces clear and concise code, and prevents and detects bugs
Produce code for the client and server with a single uniform IDE
Reuse Swift abstractions and code on the client, server, and middle tier
Dive into asynchronous programming with Swift’s support for monads and futures
Use Swift’s optional types and structures to tell the compiler more about your program

Dr. David Ungar holds a research position at IBM in the Ubiquitous Platforms group within Cloud and Mobile Enterprise Research.

Robert F. Dickerson is a software engineer in the Swift@IBM Engineering group.

Con este ebook, aprenderás a escribir toda tu aplicación en Swift, desde el cliente móvil hasta el acceso de la base de datos del nivel medio al lado del servidor.

Los autores David Ungar y Robert Dickerson te llevan a través del apoyo de Swift para la programación orientada al objeto, funcional e imperativa, y luego te muestran cómo construir un servicio web Swifty que interactúa con otros servicios y bases de datos. Al demostrar cómo Swift está relacionado con Java y Javascript, dos tecnologías líderes actualmente utilizadas en clientes y servidores hoy en día, este ebook extiende su repertorio de habilidades con uno de los idiomas más demandados de hoy.

Sumérgete en programación asincrónica con el apoyo de Swift para monadas y futuros

description:

Learning Swift Programming is a fast-paced, hands-on introduction to writing production-quality iOS and OS X apps with Apple’s new programming language. title: Reactive Programming with Swift 4
description:
'Reactive Programming with Swift 4' introduces developers to RxSwift, a framework for implementing reactive programming in iOS apps. With this book, you will learn how to create responsive, maintainable applications by mastering asynchronous data streams and reactive user interfaces. By the end, you'll be able to implement comprehensive reactive solutions using RxSwift and Xcode.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the principles and practical applications of reactive programming with RxSwift.
Master core RxSwift concepts including marble diagrams, data flows, and operators.
Learn to refactor existing codebases to employ reactive patterns for better scalability.
Gain the ability to debug and test reactive code using RxTest and other tools.
Build a complete RxSwift application using the MVVM design pattern.

Author(s)

None Singh is a software developer with extensive experience in iOS and Swift development. They specialize in modern programming paradigms like functional and reactive programming. Their approachable teaching style makes complex topics understandable for developers of all levels.

Who is it for?

This book is for iOS developers proficient in Swift who aim to reduce app complexity through modern programming approaches. No prior experience with reactive programming is assumed, making it accessible to developers seeking to explore RxSwift for the first time.

Al final, podrá implementar soluciones reactivas integrales utilizando RxSwift y Xcode.

Entender los principios y aplicaciones prácticas de la programación reactiva con RxSwift.
Master core RxSwift conceptos incluyendo diagramas de mármol, flujos de datos y operadores.
Aprende a refactorizar las bases de código existentes para emplear patrones reactivas para mejorar la escalabilidad.
Obtenga la capacidad de depurar y probar código reactivo utilizando RxTest y otras herramientas.
Construya una aplicación RxSwift completa usando el patrón de diseño MVVM.

title: Courageous Training
description: All too often—maybe even most of the time—training doesn't stick. But Tim Mooney and Robert Brinkerhoff have discovered that some iconoclastic trainers achieve breakthrough results by having the courage to break away from the usual approaches and identify what really works. In simple and engaging language they lay out the Four Pillars of Courageous Training, illustrating each with real-life examples that highlight specific concepts, methods, and tools, and include four case studies that demonstrate the mind-set needed to truly transform training and produce dramatic—and measurable—business results.

Pero Tim Mooney y Robert Brinkerhoff han descubierto que algunos entrenadores iconoclasticos logran resultados decisivos al tener el coraje de romper los enfoques habituales e identificar lo que realmente funciona. En un lenguaje sencillo y atractivo, establecen los Cuatro Pilares de la Formación Valiosa, ilustrando cada uno con ejemplos de la vida real que resaltan conceptos, métodos e instrumentos específicos, e incluyen cuatro estudios de casos que demuestran la mentalidad necesaria para transformar verdaderamente el entrenamiento y producir resultados comerciales dramáticos y mensurables.

title: Working Identity
description:
How Successful Career Changers Turn Fantasy into Reality
Whether as a daydream or a spoken desire, nearly all of us have entertained the notion of reinventing ourselves. Feeling unfulfilled, burned out, or just plain unhappy with what we’re doing, we long to make that leap into the unknown. But we also hold on, white-knuckled, to the years of time and effort we’ve invested in our current profession.
In this powerful book, Herminia Ibarra presents a new model for career reinvention that flies in the face of everything we’ve learned from "career experts." While common wisdom holds that we must first know what we want to do before we can act, Ibarra argues that this advice is backward. Knowing, she says, is the result of doing and experimenting. Career transition is not a straight path toward some predetermined identity, but a crooked journey along which we try on a host of "possible selves" we might become.
Based on her in-depth research on professionals and managers in transition, Ibarra outlines an active process of career reinvention that leverages three ways of "working identity": experimenting with new professional activities, interacting in new networks of people, and making sense of what is happening to us in light of emerging possibilities.
Through engrossing stories—from a literature professor turned stockbroker to an investment banker turned novelist—Ibarra reveals a set of guidelines that all successful reinventions share. She explores specific ways that hopeful career changers of any background can:
Explore possible selves
Craft and execute "identity experiments"
Create "small wins" that keep momentum going
Survive the rocky period between career identities
Connect with role models and mentors who can ease the transition
Make time for reflection—without missing out on windows of opportunity
Decide when to abandon the old path in order to follow the new
Arrange new events into a coherent story of who we are becoming
A call to the dreamer in each of us, Working Identity explores the process for crafting a more fulfilling future. Where we end up may surprise us.
translatedDescription:
Qué exitosos cambiadores de carrera convierten la fantasía en realidad
Ya sea como sueño o deseo hablado, casi todos hemos entretenido la noción de reinventarnos. Sentirse incumplidos, quemados, o simplemente infeliz con lo que estamos haciendo, anhelamos hacer ese salto en lo desconocido. Pero también nos aferramos a los años de tiempo y esfuerzo que hemos invertido en nuestra profesión actual.
En este poderoso libro, Herminia Ibarra presenta un nuevo modelo de reinvención profesional que vuela frente a todo lo que hemos aprendido de "expertos de cuidador". Mientras que la sabiduría común sostiene que primero debemos saber lo que queremos hacer antes de que podamos actuar, Ibarra argumenta que este consejo es atrasado. Saber, dice, es el resultado de hacer y experimentar. La transición profesional no es un camino recto hacia alguna identidad predeterminada, sino un viaje torcido a lo largo del cual tratamos en una multitud de "sólitos posibles" que podríamos llegar a ser.
Basándose en su investigación en profundidad sobre profesionales y gerentes en transición, Ibarra describe un proceso activo de reinvención profesional que aprovecha tres formas de "identidad trabajadora": experimentando con nuevas actividades profesionales, interactuando en nuevas redes de personas, y tomando sentido de lo que nos está sucediendo a la luz de las posibilidades emergentes.
A través de historias engrosantes —desde un profesor de literatura convertido en corredor de bolsa a un banquero de inversión convertido en novelista— Ibarra revela un conjunto de directrices que todas las reinvenciones exitosas comparten. Explora formas específicas que los aspirantes a cambio de carrera de cualquier fondo pueden:
Explorar posibles seres
Realizar y ejecutar "experimentos de identidad"
Crear "pequeñas victorias" que mantienen el impulso
Sobrevivir el período rocoso entre las identidades profesionales
Conectarse con modelos y mentores que pueden facilitar la transición
Hacer tiempo para la reflexión, sin perderse en las ventanas de la oportunidad
Decidir cuándo abandonar el viejo camino para seguir el nuevo
Organizar nuevos eventos en una historia coherente de a quién nos estamos convirtiendo
Una llamada al soñador en cada uno de nosotros, Working Identity explora el proceso para crear un futuro más satisfactorio. Donde terminemos puede sorprendernos.

title: Beginning iPhone Development with Swift 3: Exploring the iOS SDK, Third Edition
description:
Create your very own apps for the latest iOS devices. You'll start with the basics, and then work your way through the process of downloading and installing Xcode and the iOS 10 SDK, and then guides you though the creation of your first simple application.

Assuming little or no working knowledge of the Swift programming language, and written in a friendly, easy-to-follow style, Beginning iPhone Development with Swift 3 offers a comprehensive course in iPhone and iPad programming. In this third edition of the best-selling book, you'll learn how to integrate all the interface elements iOS users have come to know and love, such as buttons, switches, pickers, toolbars, and sliders.

Every single sample app in the book has been rebuilt from scratch using the latest Xcode and the latest iOS 10-specific project templates, and designed to take advantage of the latest Xcode features. Discover brand-new technologies, as well as significant updates to existing tools. You'll master a variety of design patterns, from the simplest single view to complex hierarchical drill-downs. The art of table building will be demystified, and you'll learn how to save your data using the iOS file system. You'll also learn how to save and retrieve your data using a variety of persistence techniques, including Core Data and SQLite. And there's much more!

What You Will Learn

Develop your own bestselling iPhone and iPad apps

Utilize Swift playgrounds

Display data in Table Views

Draw to the screen using Core Graphics

Use iOS sensor capabilities to map your world

Get your app to work with iCloud and more

Who This Book is For

Anyone who wants to start developing for iPhone and iPad.

Asumiendo poco o ningún conocimiento de trabajo del lenguaje de programación Swift, y escrito en un estilo amable y fácil de seguir, Beginning iPhone Development con Swift 3 ofrece un curso completo en la programación de iPhone y iPad. En esta tercera edición del libro más vendido, aprenderás a integrar todos los elementos de interfaz que los usuarios de iOS han venido a conocer y amar, como botones, interruptores, pickers, barras de herramientas y sliders.

Cada aplicación de muestra única en el libro ha sido reconstruida desde cero utilizando los últimos Xcode y las últimas plantillas de proyectos iOS 10 específicas, y diseñadas para aprovechar las últimas funciones de Xcode. Descubra las nuevas tecnologías, así como actualizaciones significativas de las herramientas existentes. Usted dominará una variedad de patrones de diseño, desde la simple vista única hasta complejos ejercicios jerárquicos. El arte del edificio de mesa será desmitificado, y aprenderás a guardar tus datos usando el sistema de archivos iOS. También aprenderá cómo guardar y recuperar sus datos utilizando una variedad de técnicas de persistencia, incluyendo datos básicos y SQLite. ¡Y hay mucho más!

Qué aprenderás

Desarrolla tus propias aplicaciones de iPhone y iPad de bestselling

Utilizar juegos de rol

Mostrar datos en las vistas de la tabla

Dibuja a la pantalla usando Gráficos Core

Utilice las capacidades de sensores iOS para mapear su mundo

Obtener su aplicación para trabajar con iCloud y más

Quién es este libro

Cualquiera que quiera empezar a desarrollarse para iPhone y iPad.

title: Stand Out
description:
Tools, tips and strategies to stop the cycle of 'busy' and start getting ahead

Stand Out shows you how to stop working so much, and start achieving instead. Everyone is busy, but working harder to do more isn't getting us anywhere. We're overwhelmed, distracted and detached, and our greatest fear is that this will never change. This book is your guide to taking back your life. Through simple models, robust diagnostics and practical suggestions you'll identify where you are now and how to implement real change. Explore how to move on from Check Out (the sense that you are just going through the motions), combat Burn Out (the feeling that you're on a treadmill that is dialled too fast for your legs, brain and talents to keep pace with) and move through Freak Out (that overriding anxiety generated by knowing where you want to go but not getting any traction). Real-life stories, anecdotes and ‘life hacks' provide ideas you can implement immediately, while in-depth discussion of psychological theory explains the science behind the actions. The goal is not to find your One True Passion, but to identify what's most important right now. When you're clear on purpose and actually making progress, you hit the sweet spot of activity that allows your talents to shine.

The concept of 'being at work' has changed. We're expected to be plugged in 24/7, and continually expected to do more and more with the same 24 hours in every day. Organisations suffer, families suffer and workers suffer – so why do we perpetuate this cycle? This book shows you how to hop off the hamster wheel and thrive through relentless change by doing less – but by doing it smarter.

Treat self-care as an imperative for success
Connect to what's important here and now
Stop day-dreaming and put action to purpose
Take control of your day, your path and your life

It's not about productivity training or the latest organisational system – it's about having the tools, mindset and skills in place to make your activities work for you. Stand Out helps you find the courage and optimism to live the life you crave, let go of the ‘shoulds' and shows you how to prioritise what really matters.
